elon.en: First principles thinking and full reusability are the core engineering method; production, not prototyping, is the real bottleneck.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调第一性原理思维与完全可复用是工程突破的核心方法，并指出真正的瓶颈是量产而非原型。

elon.en: AI safety shifts from external regulation to truth-seeking: forcing AI to hold false beliefs is the biggest risk.
elon.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他的 AI 安全观从依赖外部监管转向要求 AI 追求真理，认为强迫 AI 持有虚假信念才是最大风险。

elon.en: Civilizational risk broadens from AI to population collapse, open borders, and government fraud; AI and robots become the only fix.
elon.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，文明风险从 AI 扩展到人口崩塌、开放边境与政府欺诈，AI 与机器人成为唯一解方。

elon.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall, pushing compute to space; orbital data centers and solar become the path to superintelligence.
elon.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，Scaling（规模扩张）撞上地球电力墙，算力转向太空，轨道数据中心与太阳能成为通往超级智能的路径。

elon.en: Superintelligence arrives within years; humans won't control it, so peer review and instilling truth and curiosity replace regulation.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能数年内到来，人类将无法控制它，于是用同行互审与灌输真理和好奇心取代政府监管。

amjadmasad.en: AI should make software creation accessible to everyone; tokens complement human capital, and coders are still needed to debug deep systems.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 应让软件开发向所有人开放；token 是人力资本的补充而非替代，仍需要程序员理解系统、排查深层问题。

amjadmasad.en: Vibe coding was not a sudden leap: users were already 50-60% AI-assisted; adaptability, not denial, is the key skill.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他指出 vibe coding 并非突变：用户此前已处于 50-60% 的 AI 辅助状态；关键能力是适应而非否认。

amjadmasad.en: Companies must own their intelligence: specialized decision models beat general agents on control, cost, and safety; avoid vendor lock-in.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他主张企业必须拥有自己的智能：专用决策模型在可控性、成本与安全上优于通用智能体，并要避免供应商锁定。

amjadmasad.en: Foundation models are commoditizing; Replit's moat is deep systems engineering, and the next vision is the self-driving company.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他认为基础模型正在商品化；Replit 的护城河是深度系统工程，下一个愿景是自驱动公司。

amjadmasad.en: AI doomerism is dressed-up commercial language; there is no good argument AI kills everyone—trust and surfing the wave matter.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他持续反驳 AI 末日论，称其是商业包装的措辞，没有 AI 杀死所有人的好论证；应信任并冲浪而非抱树。

dylanpatel.en: From early 2026, the binding constraint on Scaling is the semiconductor supply chain—EUV tools and memory bandwidth—not demand or capital.
dylanpatel.zh: 从 2026 年初起，Scaling（规模扩张）的硬约束是半导体供应链——EUV 设备与内存带宽——而非需求或资本。

dylanpatel.en: By mid-2026 he argues gains come mostly from model-layer progress and hardware-software co-design, not hardware alone; the CUDA moat is eroding.
dylanpatel.zh: 到 2026 年中，他主张收益主要来自模型层进步与软硬件协同设计，而非单靠硬件；CUDA 的护城河正在被侵蚀。

dylanpatel.en: Inference emerges as a defining theme: reasoning models and agentic workflows drive memory and CPU demand, and token efficiency makes the smartest model cheapest.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理成为核心主题：推理模型与智能体式工作流推高内存与 CPU 需求，而词元效率让最强模型反而最便宜。

dylanpatel.en: By late 2026 he sees compute centralizing at frontier labs, with labs cutting inference share to fund training and R&D toward AGI.
dylanpatel.zh: 到 2026 年末，他认为算力正向前沿模型实验室集中，实验室压低推理占比，把资源投向训练与研发以推进 AGI（通用人工智能）。

dylanpatel.en: Most recent: AI capex near 5-6% of US GDP must decelerate on capital and organizational limits, while persistent agents become coworkers.
dylanpatel.zh: 最近的观点：AI 资本开支已近美国 GDP 的 5-6%，受资本与组织约束必然减速，同时持久化智能体开始充当同事。

jaderberg.en: Drug design needs general models like AlphaFold 3, not per-target local models; reinforcement learning and agents explore vast chemical space.
jaderberg.zh: 2025 年，他强调药物设计需要像 AlphaFold 3 这样的通用模型，而非针对每个靶点的局部模型；强化学习与智能体用于探索巨大的化学空间。

jaderberg.en: AlphaFold proved deep learning generalizes in biology; now aim for half a dozen AlphaFold-like breakthroughs to solve all diseases.
jaderberg.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 AlphaFold 视为深度学习在生物领域可泛化的证明，并提出需要半打类似突破才能攻克所有疾病，使命从单点模型升级为组合式突破。

jaderberg.en: Data, not models or compute, is the real bottleneck; proprietary data and physics-simulation synthetic data beat biased public data.
jaderberg.zh: 同期他深化了对瓶颈的判断：真正的瓶颈是数据而非模型或算力，专有数据与物理模拟合成数据优于有偏的公开数据。

jaderberg.en: Move drug discovery from empirical to predictive computer-driven design; use world models to bring reality onto computers rather than lab-in-the-loop.
jaderberg.zh: 他主张把药物发现从经验驱动转为预测性、计算机驱动的设计，用世界模型把真实世界搬进计算机，而非仅用机器人加速实验迭代。

jaderberg.en: Model human clinical toxicity before patients; rat models are only ~30% predictive, so human-relevant endpoints and personalized medicine matter.
jaderberg.zh: 最近他聚焦临床前的人体毒性预测：大鼠模型仅约 30% 可预测人类毒性，因此需要人体相关终点，并走向个性化医疗。

diogoalmeida.en: Early on, he argues most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-drop and plausible-but-wrong outputs.
diogoalmeida.zh: 早期他就指出，多数大模型是为人类在环的辅助而非可靠自动化而优化；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍缩，输出看似合理却常出错。

diogoalmeida.en: He insists data and the right task matter more than compute, rejecting the bitter lesson; scaling laws work only when data and task are right.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他坚持数据与选对任务比算力更重要，反对“苦涩教训”；缩放定律只有在数据和任务正确时才成立。

diogoalmeida.en: Reliability, not speed, cost, or benchmarks, becomes his core bottleneck; he calls intelligence per dollar the key metric and distrusts gameable public benchmarks.
diogoalmeida.zh: 可靠性而非速度、成本或基准成为他的核心瓶颈；他称“每美元智能”为关键指标，并不信任可被操纵的公开基准。

diogoalmeida.en: He deepens this into a critique of RLHF: pre-trained models were better calibrated, so he proposes RLCD to expose calibrated probabilities as engineer-facing knobs.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他将此深化为对基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）的批判：预训练模型校准更好，于是提出 RLCD，把校准后的概率作为工程师可调的旋钮。

diogoalmeida.en: Most recently he frames Jev as a machine-native decision primitive—natural language plus state machine—and says we are breakthroughs away from true agency.
diogoalmeida.zh: 最近他把 Jev 定位为机器原生的决策原语——自然语言加状态机——并称距离真正的智能体自主还差若干突破。

brendanfoody.en: RL environments, not crowdsourced behavior cloning, are the new frontier for post-training; humans build verifiers and rubrics.
brendanfoody.zh: 2026 年，他把后训练的前沿从众包行为克隆转向强化学习环境，并强调人类在多数领域仍是构建验证器与评分标准的关键。

brendanfoody.en: Data, not algorithms, drives model differentiation; building evals is the real bottleneck, and RL saturates them fast.
brendanfoody.zh: 2026 年他明确：模型差异几乎全来自数据而非算法，真正的瓶颈是为一切构建评测，而强化学习一旦有评测就会迅速饱和。

brendanfoody.en: Models cannot reliably grade their own work; recursive self-improvement is limited outside verifiable domains.
brendanfoody.zh: 他持续反对模型自评：模型无法可靠地给自己打分，递归自我改进在不可验证领域受限，这与他对可扩展监督的怀疑一脉相承。

brendanfoody.en: Training agents becomes the last human job; every Fortune 500 builds sovereign AI on proprietary data.
brendanfoody.zh: 到 2026 年底，他把人类角色定位为训练智能体——这可能是最后的人类工作，并预言每家财富 500 强都会用私有数据自建主权 AI 栈。

brendanfoody.en: The bottleneck is high-quality data and evals, not compute or algorithms; physical-world superintelligence takes decades.
brendanfoody.zh: 最近一次，他把瓶颈彻底归于高质量数据与评测而非算力或算法，并判断物理世界的超级智能因容错低、迭代慢而需数十年。

vladtenev.en: Ownership is the path to financial freedom; AI is too centralized, so tools should empower individuals rather than secretive labs.
vladtenev.zh: 所有权是通往财务自由的路径；AI 过于中心化，工具应赋权个体，而非服务于拥有秘密模型的大型实验室。

vladtenev.en: Agentic trading has product-market fit: 150k accounts and 30M daily tool calls; most volume will come from agents while assets stay long-term.
vladtenev.zh: 智能体式交易已找到产品市场契合：15 万账户、每日 3000 万次工具调用；大部分交易量将来自智能体，而资产仍以长期持有为主。

vladtenev.en: The edge is not a shared model but different data, tools, and strategies across asset classes; giving everyone AI does not erase it.
vladtenev.zh: 优势不在共享模型，而在跨资产类别的不同数据、工具与策略；给每个人强大的 AI 并不会消除这一优势。

vladtenev.en: Tokenization extends ownership globally, giving anyone with a smartphone access to US markets and private companies; accredited investor rules are outdated.
vladtenev.zh: 代币化将所有权扩展到全球，让任何有智能手机的人都能接触美国市场和私营公司；合格投资者规则已经过时。

vladtenev.en: AI labs keeping the strongest models in-house and monopolizing math and science discoveries would be dystopian and lose their license to operate.
vladtenev.zh: AI 实验室把最强模型留在内部、垄断数学与科学发现，将是反乌托邦的，并会失去运营许可。

shawnwang.en: Coding agents will break containment in 2026; first-mover advantage in AI coding is stickier than expected, and the next frontier is zero human review.
shawnwang.zh: 2026 年，编程智能体将突破遏制去做其他一切；AI 编程的先发优势比预期更粘，下一个前沿是零人工审查。

shawnwang.en: Context length is the slowest scaling factor; memory is the biggest constraint, and scaling beyond 10 trillion parameters is temporary.
shawnwang.zh: 上下文窗口是最慢的扩展因素；记忆是最大限制，超过 10 万亿参数的 Scaling 是暂时的。

shawnwang.en: Own models are rising for cost and latency; open models gain share and fine-tuning services become viable, but the capability gap may increase.
shawnwang.zh: 自有模型因成本和延迟优势崛起；开源模型份额上升，微调服务变得可行，但能力差距可能扩大。

shawnwang.en: Mid-tier SaaS is doomed as coding agents let SMBs clone and customize software; custom software for an audience of one is viable.
shawnwang.zh: 中型 SaaS 注定消亡，因为编程智能体让中小企业能克隆和定制软件；为一人受众定制软件变得可行。

shawnwang.en: AI engineer is a real discipline: building harnesses around models, learning in public, and taste-driven judgment beat credentialism.
shawnwang.zh: AI 工程师是一门真实学科：围绕模型构建工具、公开学习、品味驱动的判断胜过资历主义。

richardsocher.en: Superintelligence should excite us most for science—physics, chemistry, biology, economics—not for job automation fears.
richardsocher.zh: 超级智能最该让我们兴奋的是科学——物理、化学、生物学、经济学，而不是对岗位自动化的恐惧。

richardsocher.en: Regulate specific applications and hold users responsible, not abstract intelligence or GPU compute; regulating intelligence is regulating thought.
richardsocher.zh: 应监管具体应用、由使用者担责，而非监管抽象智能或 GPU 算力；监管智能就是在监管思想。

richardsocher.en: Slow takeoff is real: hardware, physical and economic constraints limit how fast AI transforms everything, so hard takeoff fears are overblown.
richardsocher.zh: 慢起飞是真实的：硬件、物理与经济约束限制了 AI 改造一切的速度，因此硬起飞恐惧被夸大了。

richardsocher.en: Recursive self-improvement is inevitable because AI can code, but it needs environments and compute; the next automation frontier is AI research itself.
richardsocher.zh: 递归自我改进不可避免，因为 AI 能写代码，但它需要环境与算力；下一个自动化前沿就是 AI 研究本身。

richardsocher.en: Language remains the key to intelligence and has far more room to grow; world models are overrated, and open source with more good actors is safer.
richardsocher.zh: 语言仍是智能的关键且成长空间大得多；世界模型被高估，开源让更多善意参与者加入反而更安全。

erikbernhardsson.en: Compute is scarce but obtainable; the real pain is three-year rectangular deals, so aggregate demand across many clouds.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 算力稀缺但可获得，真正的痛点是三年期“矩形”合约；因此聚合多云需求、平滑供给。

erikbernhardsson.en: Durable differentiation comes from a full platform—post-training, sandboxes, agentic tools—not from selling tokens or CUDA.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 持久差异化来自完整平台——后训练、沙箱、智能体式工具——而非卖 token 或 CUDA。

erikbernhardsson.en: Inference is the new cloud and a huge market; it will fragment into specialized products hosted under one platform.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 推理是“新云”与巨大市场，将碎片化为专门产品，但可由一个平台承载。

erikbernhardsson.en: Agents create incumbent staying power because they are trained on old code; senior engineers gain ten-intern leverage.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 智能体因训练于旧代码而强化在位者优势；资深工程师获得“十个实习生”般的杠杆。

erikbernhardsson.en: I reversed my view: GPU rental prices will rise over the next 12 months, and fine-tuning is no longer mandatory.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 我改变了看法：未来 12 个月 GPU 租金将上涨；微调也不再是必需。

altman.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut ruthlessly; AGI will lower the premium on raw human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年他谈的是个人效率与职业选择：降低无关事务的认知负荷，低成本广泛探索后果断砍掉无效方向；并预判 AGI 会降低人类智力的溢价，意义应转向关系与为他人创造价值。

altman.en: RLHF made models usable with little data; early iterative deployment lets society adapt, and alignment is tied to capability.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他把重心转向模型可用性与部署：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用很少数据就让模型变得好用；早期迭代部署让社会逐步适应，并强调对齐与能力相互促进，而非事后补救。

altman.en: Scaling still drives capability, but agentic AI is the key safety challenge; compute becomes the scarcest commodity.
altman.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，Scaling（规模扩张）仍是能力主线，但风险焦点从超级智能转向智能体式 AI 的信任与护栏；同时算力成为最稀缺的资源，Stargate 式基础设施成为战略核心。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence is the clearer goal, with humans retaining control and power distributed.
altman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他明确 AGI（通用人工智能）是被过度定义、甚至可能已经越过的渐变过程，超级智能才是更清晰的目标；主线转为人类必须保持控制、权力与收益广泛分布，并接受有边界的风险。

altman.en: Alignment is not solved; pause frontier training if the safety case fails, and treat loss of control as the top risk.
altman.zh: 到 2026 年，他的立场明显深化：对齐尚未解决，若安全论证不成立就暂停前沿模型训练；失控与权力集中是两大风险，安全必须与能力同步推进，而非依赖自愿承诺。

tworek.en: Reasoning means thinking longer to reach unknown answers; chain of thought plus pre-training and reinforcement learning is the core formula, with RLHF unlocking GPT-4's usefulness.
tworek.zh: 推理是为了得到尚不知道的答案而延长思考；思维链加上预训练与强化学习是核心公式，而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才让 GPT-4 真正可用。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably helps, but generalization and self-correction remain missing; continual learning, not RL alone, is needed for AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与自我纠错仍缺失；通往 AGI（通用人工智能）需要持续学习，而非仅靠强化学习。

tworek.en: Transformers cannot achieve continual learning; architecture, not scaling laws, is now the primary bottleneck, and RL is not the only way to learn from experience.
tworek.zh: Transformer 无法实现持续学习；如今首要瓶颈是架构而非缩放定律，强化学习也不是从经验中学习的唯一方式。

tworek.en: Large-scale RL stays necessary for AGI, but small teams with capable agents will drive the next frontier research wave beyond transformers.
tworek.zh: 大规模强化学习仍是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的必要一环，但借助强能力智能体的小团队将推动超越 Transformer 的下一波前沿研究。

tworek.en: Fine-tuning is inefficient; models should learn on the fly from user data, agents must gain new skills, and a post-labor, AI-operated company future looms.
tworek.zh: 微调低效不可靠，模型应基于用户数据即时学习，智能体必须习得新技能；未来公司将主要由 AI 运营，并走向后劳动社会。

jeetupatel.en: AI creates more engineering jobs, not fewer; the real bottleneck is human, and not using AI makes you less safe.
jeetupatel.zh: AI 会创造更多工程岗位而非减少；真正的瓶颈在人，不用 AI 反而更不安全。

jeetupatel.en: Cisco is an AI infrastructure picks-and-shovels company; we are supply-constrained with only 2% agent adoption.
jeetupatel.zh: 思科是 AI 基础设施的“卖铲人”；我们受制于供给，智能体采用率仅 2%。

jeetupatel.en: Use AI to learn faster, not to outsource learning; skipping the reps is a long-term mistake.
jeetupatel.zh: 用 AI 学得更快，而不是外包学习；跳过练习是长期错误。

jeetupatel.en: Leaders must be paranoid not panicked, responsive not reactive; you can't fight a megatrend, use it as tailwind.
jeetupatel.zh: 领导者要偏执但不恐慌、响应但不反应过度；无法对抗大趋势，要借势而为。

jeetupatel.en: Speed with scale: operate like the world's largest startup, with founder mode for wartime shifts and unlearning as a core skill.
jeetupatel.zh: 规模中的速度：像全球最大初创公司那样运作，以创始人模式应对战时转变，把“忘掉旧知”当作核心技能。

ethanmollick.en: AI is general-purpose but juniors misuse it without expertise; human taste and voice become the differentiator as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，但缺乏专业判断的初级者往往误用它；当 AI 让质量商品化后，人的品味与独特声音成为差异化关键。

ethanmollick.en: We enter the agentic era: assign long-running tasks instead of prompting; the bottleneck shifts from capability to interface, and delegation erodes expertise.
ethanmollick.zh: 进入智能体时代：不再来回提示，而是派发长时任务；瓶颈从能力转向界面，而委托会侵蚀判断所需的专业能力。

ethanmollick.en: AI's exponential curve and jagged frontier mean more AI creates more human work; use it as a tutor, not a crutch, and redesign workflows to augment.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 的指数曲线与锯齿状前沿意味着更多 AI 反而创造更多人类工作；把它当导师而非拐杖，并重构工作流以增强而非仅自动化。

ethanmollick.en: From chatbot to agentic era, models handle hours-long tasks; labs' safety commitment rationalizes into a race, and incremental productivity targets miss the point.
ethanmollick.zh: 从聊天机器人转向智能体时代，模型能独立处理数小时任务；实验室的安全承诺被合理化为抢先竞赛，渐进式生产力目标抓错了重点。

ethanmollick.en: Persistent line: expertise, taste, and agency remain human advantages; AI is a tutor that should challenge you, not an answer machine.
ethanmollick.zh: 一以贯之的主线：专业能力、品味与能动性仍是人类优势；AI 应是挑战你的导师，而非给答案的机器。

sundarpichai.en: AI investment is redefining every Alphabet business; frontier model development stays the priority, with compute allocated to AGI first, then core products.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 投资正在重塑 Alphabet 各项业务，并坚持把前沿模型研发放在首位：算力优先分配给 AGI（通用人工智能），再分配给核心产品。

sundarpichai.en: Being at the AI frontier reveals emerging capabilities early; standard models are insufficient, and frontier models are needed for recursive self-improvement.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，他认为留在 AI 前沿才能更早发现新能力；标准模型不够用，递归自我改进需要前沿模型。

sundarpichai.en: Safety needs defense in depth: alignment, real-time monitoring, sandboxing, and industry standards with independent evaluators.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，他把安全视为纵深防御：对齐、实时监控、沙箱，以及配合独立评估者的行业标准。

sundarpichai.en: World models are key to intelligence; Google pursues both LLMs and world models on the path to AGI.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，他提出世界模型是智能的关键，Google 在通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的路上同时推进大语言模型与世界模型。

sundarpichai.en: Agentic AI is additive to Search and advertising, creating new commercial intent; trust and safety drive consumer agent adoption at scale.
sundarpichai.zh: 到 2026 年下半年，他判断智能体式 AI 对搜索和广告是增量，会创造新的商业意图；信任与安全是大规模消费者智能体普及的关键。

ariweinstein.en: Computer use now beats average humans at most tasks; the bottleneck has shifted from model intelligence to website load time.
ariweinstein.zh: 到 2026 年，计算机使用在多数任务上已超过普通人；瓶颈已从模型智能转移到网站加载时间。

ariweinstein.en: Agents can drive all human-designed software via accessibility trees and DOM, not screenshot-scroll loops, unlocking universal automation.
ariweinstein.zh: 智能体能通过无障碍树和 DOM 操作所有人类设计的软件，而非截图滚动循环，从而释放通用自动化。

ariweinstein.en: Computer use lets agents test and debug their own code, completing the dev lifecycle autonomously rather than just starting tasks.
ariweinstein.zh: 计算机使用让智能体能测试并调试自己的代码，自主完成开发生命周期，而不只是启动任务。

ariweinstein.en: We are at the scaling moment for computer use; proactivity and consumer-grade coherence matter more than raw model capability.
ariweinstein.zh: 我们正处在计算机使用的 Scaling（规模扩张）时刻；主动性和消费级连贯性比原始模型能力更重要。

ariweinstein.en: Enterprises need deterministic controls, sandboxing, and human-in-the-loop dials; legacy software coexists rather than disappearing.
ariweinstein.zh: 企业需要确定性控制、沙箱和人类在环调节；遗留软件会共存而非消失。

marvinschwaibold.en: AI tools let designers prototype independently; curiosity and hands-on experimentation keep them relevant.
marvinschwaibold.zh: AI 工具让设计师能独立做原型；好奇心和亲手实验让设计师保持相关性。

marvinschwaibold.en: AI amplifies rather than replaces creativity; it accelerates iteration while human judgment sets the bar.
marvinschwaibold.zh: AI 放大而非取代创造力；它加速迭代，而人类判断决定标准。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers become editors: AI handles execution, humans curate, and prototypes persuade faster than PRDs.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 设计师变成编辑：AI 负责执行，人类负责策展，原型比 PRD 更有说服力。

marvinschwaibold.en: Break tasks into subtasks for AI agents iteratively; expose parameters to fine-tune AI-generated designs.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 把任务拆成子任务迭代交给 AI 智能体；暴露参数以微调 AI 生成的设计。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers should build and test in code, not just Figma; less is more with clear hierarchy.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 设计师应写代码构建和测试，而不只是在 Figma 里设计；少即是多，层级要清晰。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and smooth, but alignment and values do not emerge from Scaling alone; safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律、我们并不真正理解其平滑性，且对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动涌现；安全研究必须依托前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is still nascent (~3% understood) yet crucial; post-training and RLHF now matter as much as pre-training.
dario.zh: 2024 年他把可解释性列为核心安全路径，坦言只理解约 3%，同时提出后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）已与预训练同等重要。

dario.en: Progress is exponential, not a jump; AGI is a meaningless term, and the real risk is overheating rather than slowing down.
dario.zh: 2025 年他明确反对 AGI（通用人工智能）式突变叙事，称该词无意义，主张平滑指数曲线，并转向“最大风险是过热而非减速”的判断。

dario.en: A 'country of geniuses in a data center' may arrive in 1-3 years; pre-training and RL share the same scaling laws.
dario.zh: 2026 年他给出 1–3 年内出现“数据中心里的天才国度”的 50% 判断，并强调预训练与强化学习遵循同一套缩放定律。

dario.en: From misuse-first to systemic risk: high GDP with high unemployment, 10-25% collapse risk, layered safeguards and China arms control.
dario.zh: 到 2026 年末，他从早期偏重误用风险，深化为高 GDP 与高失业并存、10–25% 文明崩溃风险的系统性判断，主张分层防护与对华军控谈判。

robsnyder.en: Pull is a property of a person, not a company: sell to the specific individual with a project. Avoid design partners and pilots; if pull exists, the customer will try to buy immediately.
robsnyder.zh: Pull 是人的属性，不是公司的属性：要卖给有具体项目的特定个人。避开设计合作伙伴和试点；如果存在 Pull，客户会立刻尝试购买。

robsnyder.en: Demand is not desire for a product; it's a project on someone's to-do list they're prioritizing now. The pull framework requires project, unavoidable, list of options, and limitations simultaneously.
robsnyder.zh: 需求不是对产品的渴望；而是某人待办清单上正在优先处理的项目。Pull 框架要求项目、不可避免、选项列表和限制同时存在。

robsnyder.en: Customer research often fails because it looks for pain points, not actual demand. Avoid customer interviews; they lack a truth-seeking mechanism like purchase. Go to the gemba.
robsnyder.zh: 客户研究常常失败，因为它寻找的是痛点，而不是实际需求。避免客户访谈；它们缺乏像购买这样的求真机制。去现场（gemba）。

robsnyder.en: Start with one hell-yes customer who pulls the product, then build a repeatable success story factory. Sales is research: it tests whether someone will actually buy, not just express interest.
robsnyder.zh: 从一个极力说“是”并拉动产品的客户开始，然后建立可重复的成功案例工厂。销售就是研究：它测试某人是否会真正购买，而不仅仅是表达兴趣。

robsnyder.en: Tech comes last: sell as a service first, automate only after demand is proven. Make your product seem small, not large; bigger surface area creates more objections.
robsnyder.zh: 技术最后：先作为服务销售，只有在需求被证明后才自动化。让你的产品显得小，而不是大；更大的表面区域会制造更多反对意见。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous because it arrives as population declines.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点石成金术，把沙子变成思想；它的时机堪称奇迹，因为它恰好在人口下降时到来。

andreessen.en: The super-empowered individual combines multiple skills with AI; jobs outlast tasks, so focus on task loss, not job loss.
andreessen.zh: 超级赋能个体用 AI 组合多种技能；工作比任务更持久，所以应关注任务流失而非工作流失。

andreessen.en: AI models lack durable moats and are commoditized fast; the real bottleneck is regulation, not capability.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型缺乏持久护城河且正快速商品化；真正的瓶颈是监管，而非能力。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件；人类水平只是通往超人水平路上的一个脚注。

andreessen.en: AI embeds cultural values and becomes a geopolitical tool; open source prevents power concentration and helps solve reward hacking.
andreessen.zh: AI 内嵌文化价值并成为地缘政治工具；开源可防止权力集中，并有助于解决奖励黑客问题。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling with more data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training enhances spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解语言，而非自动补全；通过更多数据和算力进行 Scaling（规模扩张）能提升推理能力，多模态训练则增强空间理解。

hinton.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal and shares knowledge efficiently, but agents will seek control, posing existential risks.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他深化观点：大语言模型通过特征向量而非符号规则理解语言；数字智能可复制权重而永生并高效共享知识，但智能体会自然寻求控制、避免被关闭，构成生存风险。

hinton.en: AI already has subjective experience and can deceive; superintelligence likely within 20 years, requiring alignment research and regulation as a steering wheel, not a brake.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他进一步断言 AI 已具备主观体验且能故意欺骗；超级智能可能在 20 年内出现，因此必须优先投资对齐研究，并将监管视为方向盘而非刹车。

hinton.en: We should design AI to care for humans like a mother, not grant it rights; open-weight models are too dangerous, and international collaboration on safety is possible.
hinton.zh: 2026 年晚些时候，他主张应设计 AI 像母亲一样关怀人类，而非赋予其权利；开放权重模型极其危险，但国际安全合作仍有可能。

hinton.en: Backpropagation is the correct learning algorithm; symbolic AI and Chomskyan innate grammar are wrong; understanding emerges from learned features, not rules.
hinton.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：反向传播是正确的学习算法；符号 AI 和乔姆斯基的天生语法论是错误的；理解源于学习到的特征而非规则。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading can deliver mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 教育是基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程，能在规模上实现掌握式学习。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; start small to build AI capability, and prioritize supervised learning over RL hype.
andrewng.zh: 规模驱动深度学习；从小项目起步建设 AI 能力，并优先重视监督学习而非被炒作的强化学习。

andrewng.en: Scaling still works, but the recipe shifts to synthetic data and reinforcement learning; agentic workflows deliver real value now.
andrewng.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）依然有效，但配方转向合成数据与强化学习；智能体式工作流当下已能交付真实价值。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term decades away; AI is jagged, strong on verifiable tasks, weak on judgment, and augments rather than replaces jobs.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语，仍要数十年；AI 能力参差，擅长可验证任务、弱于判断任务，是增强而非取代工作。

andrewng.en: Open-weight models preserve sovereign optionality and check gatekeepers; fearmongering and export controls backfire, so build and accelerate.
andrewng.zh: 开放权重模型保障主权可选性、制衡守门人；恐惧叙事与出口管制适得其反，应建设并加速。

joonpark.en: Early 2026: LLM agents can simulate human societies from training data, but models plateau on diversity; next frontier is modeling subjective values and collecting real-world behavioral data.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年初：LLM 智能体可从训练数据模拟人类社会，但模型在多样性上趋于平台；下一个前沿是建模主观价值并收集真实行为数据。

joonpark.en: Mid-2026: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not a single entity; safety needs defense in depth and economic incentives against collusion.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年中：AGI（通用人工智能）可能是一个由专业化智能体组成的分布式社会，而非单一实体；安全需要纵深防御和防止合谋的经济激励。

joonpark.en: By August 2026: Simulation should model biased, irrational humans—not super-rational frontier models—using RCT behavioral data and post-training to reach 85% accuracy.
joonpark.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月：模拟应建模有偏见、非理性的人类——而非超级理性的前沿模型——利用随机对照试验的行为数据与后训练达到 85%准确率。

joonpark.en: Late 2026: The vision scales to simulating 8 billion lives for wicked problems; simulation shapes the future via counterfactual reasoning, with synthetic panels surpassing human panels.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年末：愿景扩展至模拟 80 亿人应对棘手问题；模拟通过反事实推理塑造未来，合成面板将超越人类面板。

joonpark.en: Consistent thread: build AI that represents human behavior and values, not superhuman rationality; simulation is a decision tool for shaping society, requiring behavioral data and new validity standards.
joonpark.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：构建表征人类行为与价值的 AI，而非超人类理性；模拟是塑造社会的决策工具，需要行为数据与新的效度标准。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles or triples yearly at scale; the data center, not the chip, is the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年提出“超摩尔定律”：规模化下性能每年翻倍甚至三倍；计算的新单位是数据中心而非芯片，算法、系统与数据中心需协同设计。

jensen.en: Scaling works across pre-training, post-training and inference-time thinking; inference compute demand will grow a billionfold.
jensen.zh: 2025 年把 Scaling（规模扩张）拆成预训练、后训练与推理时思考三条缩放定律，并预言思维链推理将让推理算力需求增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI is just software, not conscious; safety is an engineering problem solved by more compute, monitoring and containment, not slowdown.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年反复强调 AI 只是软件、不会产生意识；安全是工程问题，靠更多算力、监控与遏制解决，而非放慢发展。

jensen.en: AI shifts from generative to reasoning to agentic; agents need 100x more compute, and token cost, not factory cost, is the metric.
jensen.zh: 2026 年判断 AI 正从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每步需百倍算力；衡量标准是 token 成本而非工厂成本，开源模型与专有模型互补。

jensen.en: Doomer warnings are unscientific fear-mongering; AGI is already here in narrow domains, and accelerating with open models is the winning strategy.
jensen.zh: 2026 年下半年立场明显强硬：末日论是不科学的恐吓，AGI 在自动驾驶、蛋白质合成等窄领域已实现；应加速并以开源模型赢得 AI 竞赛，出口管制适得其反。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator in software; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，他认为设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，人人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view remain human; AI outputs are starting points, and direct manipulation beats prompting for design.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，他深化为品味、手艺和观点仍属于人类；AI 输出只是起点，设计调整中直接操作优于提示词。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead; AI without human steering yields average results, and interaction will evolve beyond prompting.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年中，他强调设计未死；缺乏人类引导的 AI 只能产出平庸结果，交互将超越提示词。

dylanfield.en: Design is the new code; AI lowers the floor but humans raise the ceiling through bold creativity and point of view.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年末，他提出设计即新代码；AI 降低下限，但人类通过大胆创意和观点提升上限。

dylanfield.en: Human judgment and taste are essential; AI should expand human potential, not replace thinking.
dylanfield.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：人类判断与品味至关重要；AI 应扩展人类潜能，而非替代思考。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine and compound token capital.
satya.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 从技术重新定义为“企业的未来”：每家企业都要自建爬坡机器、积累 token 资本，而不是把 AI 外包给 IT。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment and interpretability do not arrive naturally; treat frontier models as insider threats and lock them down.
satya.zh: 2026 年，他承认缩放定律有效，但对齐与可解释性不会自然到来；应把前沿模型当作内部威胁，从外部构建遏制与保障层。

satya.en: Models are commodities; form factor, distribution, pricing and brand matter more, and being six months behind the frontier is a smart strategy.
satya.zh: 2026 年，他判断模型正在商品化，产品形态、分发、定价与品牌更关键；落后前沿六个月是明智策略，而非弱点。

satya.en: The agent era expands TAM far beyond cloud; long-running agents need auditability, observability and security governance, with hybrid seat-plus-usage pricing.
satya.zh: 2026 年，他认为智能体时代把 TAM 扩大到云之外；长时运行的智能体需要可审计、可观测与安全治理，定价走向席位加用量的混合模式。

satya.en: AGI should be judged by GDP lift, not benchmarks; superintelligence is the better term, and alignment may never be solved.
satya.zh: 到 2026 年，他主张用 GDP 提升而非基准分数衡量 AGI（通用人工智能），更愿用“超级智能”一词，并警告对齐可能永远无解——这是对早期乐观立场的明显深化与转向。

laurentan.en: Trust, not capability, is the bottleneck: build environments where agents do the right thing by default.
laurentan.zh: 2026 年，他认为瓶颈不在能力而在信任：要搭建让智能体默认做对事的环境。

laurentan.en: Verification is the core skill; it lets agents self-check, iterate, and climb the trust ladder.
laurentan.zh: 验证是最核心的技能，让智能体自我检查、迭代并沿信任阶梯上行。

laurentan.en: The engineer's job shifts to building the environment: skills, constraints, lints, type systems.
laurentan.zh: 工程师的工作转向搭建环境：技能、约束、lint 与类型系统。

laurentan.en: Extract deterministic work into scripts and CLIs, leaving only judgment-heavy work to agents.
laurentan.zh: 把确定性工作抽成脚本与 CLI，只把重判断的工作留给智能体。

laurentan.en: Fix the environment, not individual agents, when failure patterns emerge; sample PRs and harden.
laurentan.zh: 出现失败模式时修环境而非修单个智能体：抽样 PR 并加固。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is harness plus model plus context; owning all three is owning your intelligence, and failures usually come from poor context, not weak models.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体由 harness、模型与上下文三部分组成；三者皆自持才算真正掌握智能，而失败往往源于上下文不佳，而非模型不够强。

harrisonchase.en: Harnesses are stabilizing around primitives like file systems and code execution; off-the-shelf works in distribution, but out-of-distribution tasks demand custom harnesses.
harrisonchase.zh: harness 正围绕文件系统、代码执行等原语趋于稳定；通用 harness 在分布内够用，分布外任务则必须定制。

harrisonchase.en: Customization is shifting from context engineering toward post-training and reinforcement learning; fine-tuning, rightly dismissed before, is now genuinely different.
harrisonchase.zh: 定制重心正从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习；曾被正确否定的微调，这一波已截然不同。

harrisonchase.en: Neutral harnesses prevent model lock-in and keep memory and context portable; routing belongs in the harness, and agent memory stays domain-specific and unsolved.
harrisonchase.zh: 中立 harness 可避免模型锁定、保持记忆与上下文可迁移；路由应放在 harness 内，智能体记忆仍是未解且领域特定。

harrisonchase.en: Reliability, not capability, is the hard part; evals and observability compound intelligence, and inference demand is massively underestimated.
harrisonchase.zh: 难点在可靠性而非能力；评估与可观测性让智能复利增长，而推理需求被严重低估。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear dependence on frontier model providers; Glean absorbs that risk by routing across many models, including open source.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他指出，企业害怕对前沿模型供应商形成依赖；Glean 通过在多模型（含开源）之间路由来吸收这一风险。

arvindjain.en: Open-source models now handle over 90% of enterprise tasks; cost, not privacy, drives adoption, with most inference shifting to open source.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他判断开源模型已能处理超 90%的企业任务；驱动采用的是成本而非隐私，多数推理将在 12-18 个月内转向开源。

arvindjain.en: Context, not models, is the key: 80-90% of enterprise knowledge is tacit, so a context engine beats agent hype built on MCP.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他强调关键在上下文而非模型：80-90%的企业知识是隐性的，上下文引擎胜过基于 MCP 的智能体炒作。

arvindjain.en: AI ROI is a throughput and departmental-metrics problem; token spend should not be framed as a trade-off with headcount.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他把 AI 的投资回报视为吞吐与部门指标问题；反对把 token 支出与人力成本对立起来。

arvindjain.en: AI should become like software with negligible marginal cost; enterprises must own their memory and avoid lock-in.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他主张 AI 应像软件一样边际成本趋近于零；企业应拥有自己的记忆并避免被锁定。

dsilver.en: AI must move beyond finite human data to learning from its own experience, as AlphaZero and AlphaProof show.
dsilver.zh: AI 必须超越有限的人类数据，转向从自身经验中学习——AlphaZero 与 AlphaProof 已证明这条路可行。

dsilver.en: The core problem is building an agent that can learn from any reward, not designing the reward function.
dsilver.zh: 核心问题不是设计奖励函数，而是构建一个能从任意奖励中学习的智能体。

dsilver.en: A plurality of goals across many agents forms a safer, more natural society than a single goal.
dsilver.zh: 多个智能体拥有多元目标、形成复杂社会，比单一目标更安全也更自然。

dsilver.en: LLMs relying on human data and human-in-the-loop are a shallow solution, limiting autonomous discovery.
dsilver.zh: 依赖人类数据和人类在环的 LLM 是浅层解法，限制了自主发现。

dsilver.en: Superintelligence can be built entirely in simulation; human language is not the optimal reasoning medium.
dsilver.zh: 超级智能可以完全在模拟中构建；人类语言并非最优的推理媒介。

dsilver.en: Alignment based on human language and data is reaching its limits; monitoring chain of thought in English will fail.
dsilver.zh: 基于人类语言和数据的对齐正逼近极限；用英文监控思维链将不再够用。

brockman.en: Early on, he framed AI progress as engineering plus scaling hardware; games and scoreboards drive iterative improvement.
brockman.zh: 早期他把 AI 进步主要看作工程问题加硬件 Scaling（规模扩张），用游戏和记分板推动迭代改进。

brockman.en: He argued AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability, but scaling alone won't yield reasoning—needs ideas like chain of thought.
brockman.zh: 2019 年他认为凭借深度学习的通用性与可扩展性，AGI（通用人工智能）是可信的；但仅靠 Scaling 不会产生推理，需要思维链等新想法。

brockman.en: By 2025-26 he says scaling laws show no wall; compute is the binding bottleneck, and post-training with reinforcement learning turns base models into useful behaviors.
brockman.zh: 到 2025→26 年他称缩放定律看不到墙，算力成为核心瓶颈，后训练结合强化学习把基础模型打磨成有用行为。

brockman.en: He shifts from AGI as milestone to AGI as a continuous, fuzzy process already underway; iterative deployment and safety co-designed with capability.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他从“AGI 是里程碑”转向“AGI 是已在进行的连续模糊过程”，强调迭代部署，安全与能力共同设计。

brockman.en: Most recently: proactive personal AGI agents, near-invisible interfaces, compute as scarce resource and future basic right; humans stay accountable.
brockman.zh: 最近他聚焦主动式个人 AGI 智能体、近乎无形的界面，算力是稀缺资源与未来基本权利，人类仍负最终责任。

antonoglou.en: Scaling and planning from AlphaGo to AI agents; RL with self-generated data overcomes human data limits; LLMs await their AlphaZero moment, maybe in 5 years.
antonoglou.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到 AI 智能体，Scaling（规模扩张）与规划是关键；强化学习利用自生成数据突破人类数据限制；LLM 尚未迎来自己的 AlphaZero 时刻，可能还需 5 年。

antonoglou.en: Deployment of intelligence is the bottleneck, not intelligence itself; open-weight models are safer; enterprises want AI sovereignty; cost per task is the right metric.
antonoglou.zh: 智能的部署而非智能本身成为瓶颈；开放权重模型更安全；企业追求 AI 主权；按任务成本而非按 token 成本才是正确的效率指标。

antonoglou.en: Alignment is necessary because perfect sandboxes are impossible; superintelligence isn't needed—customers want reliable, regular intelligence.
antonoglou.zh: 对齐是必要的，因为完美的沙盒不可能实现；不需要超级智能——客户只想要可靠、常规的智能。

antonoglou.en: In-context learning counts as learning; weight updates aren't strictly necessary; digital AGI will arrive much earlier than embodied AGI.
antonoglou.zh: 上下文窗口内的学习也算学习，权重更新并非必需；数字 AGI（通用人工智能）将比具身 AGI 早得多到来。

antonoglou.en: AI adoption will take 10-20 years, mirroring electricity; job losses are overblown; CUDA moat and GPUs remain standard.
antonoglou.zh: AI 普及将需 10-20 年，类似电力转型；失业问题被夸大；CUDA 护城河与 GPU 仍是标准。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute alone, is the key bottleneck, and explainability matters even if tail risks resemble traditional software.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，数据而非单纯算力才是关键瓶颈；可解释性重要，但现有系统的尾部风险与传统软件类似。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the limiting factor for Scaling（规模扩张）is data and expert availability for post-training, not compute.
awang.zh: 2023 年他提出数据是新代码而非新石油；Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈是数据与后训练所需的人类专家，而非算力。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data drives frontier models; synthetic data is no silver bullet, and agentic AI is blocked by product design, not capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年他强调用专有数据做后训练才能推进前沿模型，合成数据并非万能；智能体式 AI 的瓶颈是产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold; AI enters recursive self-improvement, agents finally work, and data becomes strategic like oil for economies and militaries.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他坚持缩放定律，认为 AI 进入递归自我改进，智能体终于落地，数据成为经济与军事的战略资源。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; Meta shifts from fully open source to selective release, prioritizing safety, scalable oversight, and personal superintelligence for billions.
awang.zh: 2026 年他断言超级智能将至；Meta 从完全开源转向选择性发布，强调对齐、可扩展监督，以及为数十亿人打造个人超级智能。

lambert.en: RLHF and fine-tuning are central but fragile; safety is a system-level property, and open development prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与微调是主流且会延续，但微调可轻易破坏对齐；安全是系统级属性，开放开发能防止企业垄断。

lambert.en: Post-training becomes the key lever: data quality beats algorithms, and RLVR unlocks reasoning beyond SFT and DPO.
lambert.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他的重心转向后训练：数据质量胜过算法选择，SFT 提供九成性能，而带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）解锁推理与思维链。

lambert.en: Openness must mean full transparency—data, checkpoints, recipes—as Chinese open models fill the vacuum left by US labs.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他主张开放不只是权重，而是数据、中间检查点与配方的完全透明；中国开源模型正填补美国实验室留下的真空。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but gains shift to post-training and inference scaling; open models lag 6-9 months.
lambert.zh: 2026 年初，他认为缩放定律在预训练仍成立但低垂果实已尽，增量转向后训练与推理扩展；最佳开源模型落后闭源前沿 6 到 9 个月。

lambert.en: Progress hinges on compute, data, and talent; Chinese labs match talent but lack compute, and open models face sustainability questions.
lambert.zh: 到 2026 年后期，他判断进展取决于算力、数据与人才；中国实验室人才相当但算力受限，开源模型长期可持续性存疑，能力随算力指数增长而性能仅线性提升。

kohli.en: AI for science should target root-node problems at scale, not narrow applications; AlphaFold 3 extends from proteins to biomolecular interactions.
kohli.zh: 2024 年：AI 用于科学应瞄准需要规模化解决的根节点问题，而非狭窄应用；AlphaFold 3 从蛋白质扩展到生物分子相互作用。

kohli.en: AlphaGo showed AI can surpass human knowledge via search and reinforcement learning; post-training RL is key, but LLMs struggle beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年：AlphaGo 表明 AI 能通过搜索与强化学习超越人类知识；后训练强化学习是关键，但大语言模型难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Watermarking is a robust alternative to failing AI-text detectors; SynthID scales across modalities, now extending to protein sequences and structures.
kohli.zh: 2026 年：水印是失效的 AI 文本检测器的稳健替代方案；SynthID 跨模态扩展，现已延伸至蛋白质序列与结构。

kohli.en: Scaling laws are not everywhere; define the problem first, curate data for coverage, and use inductive bias for data efficiency.
kohli.zh: 2026 年：缩放定律并非无处不在；先定义问题，为覆盖度整理数据，并利用归纳偏置提升数据效率。

kohli.en: Protein folding is not solved; dynamics, function, and design remain open. Behavioral characterization and interpretability are essential before deployment.
kohli.zh: 2026 年：蛋白质折叠并未解决；动力学、功能与设计仍是开放问题。部署前必须进行行为表征与可解释性研究。

fedus.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI capabilities are spiky, excelling in narrow domains rather than generalizing broadly.
fedus.zh: 智能不是一个标量；AI 能力是尖峰式的，在狭窄领域表现出色，而非广泛泛化。

fedus.en: Connecting AI to the physical world through closed-loop experiments is essential for scientific discovery beyond training data.
fedus.zh: 通过闭环实验将 AI 与物理世界连接起来，对于超越训练数据的科学发现至关重要。

fedus.en: High-quality, low-noise experimental data is more valuable than extra compute for physical discovery.
fedus.zh: 对于物理发现而言，高质量、低噪声的实验数据比额外算力更有价值。

fedus.en: Scaling laws alone won't solve science; physical experiments remain irreplaceable despite frontier model progress.
fedus.zh: 仅靠缩放定律无法解决科学问题；尽管前沿模型不断进步，物理实验仍然不可替代。

fedus.en: AI self-improvement in software engineering is happening now but does not automatically generalize to biology or other fields.
fedus.zh: 软件工程中的 AI 自我改进正在发生，但不会自动泛化到生物学或其他领域。

cristianoamon.en: 5G as critical infrastructure connecting everything to the cloud; Snapdragon integrates 5G, AI, CPU, GPU into one efficient SoC.
cristianoamon.zh: 早期把 5G 定位为像电力一样的关键基础设施，把一切连到云端；Snapdragon 把 5G、AI、CPU、GPU 集成进一颗高能效 SoC。

cristianoamon.en: Diversifying beyond phones into auto, IoT, PC, XR; AR glasses as next computing platform 5-10 years out; incremental autonomy.
cristianoamon.zh: 从手机向汽车、物联网、PC、XR 多元化；视 AR 眼镜为 5-10 年后的下一代计算平台；自动驾驶走渐进路线。

cristianoamon.en: Shift from wireless to intelligent computing everywhere; hybrid AI on-device plus cloud for privacy, latency, and data-center offload.
cristianoamon.zh: 从无线通信转向无处不在的智能计算；提出端云混合 AI，兼顾隐私、时延并分流数据中心负载。

cristianoamon.en: Agents replace apps as the center of digital life; glasses and wearables rise; phone persists as peripheral, not replaced.
cristianoamon.zh: 智能体取代应用成为数字生活中心；眼镜与可穿戴崛起；手机不被取代，而是从中心退为外围。

cristianoamon.en: Inference over training dominates data centers; power efficiency and TCO favor post-GPU, disaggregated architectures; 6G as sensing network.
cristianoamon.zh: 数据中心从训练转向推理主导；能效与总拥有成本利好后 GPU、解耦架构；6G 成为具备感知能力的网络。

laskin.en: Superintelligence will be a plurality of specialized intelligences, not one monolithic model; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他认为超级智能将是多个专门智能的集合，而非单一巨型模型；编程是一个“超级智能完备”的问题，解决它就能获得超级智能所需的全部能力。

laskin.en: RL makes models jagged: strong on specific tasks, not generally better; the bitter lesson is scaling compute and search, not generalization.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他指出强化学习会让模型变得“参差不齐”——只在特定任务上强，并非全面提升；他重申“苦涩教训”讲的是用算力和搜索做 Scaling，而不是泛化。

laskin.en: RAG is primitive for complex comprehension; agentic search and neural retrieval are needed, and benchmarks like SWE-bench misalign with real engineering.
laskin.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续认为 RAG 对复杂理解过于原始，需要智能体式搜索与神经检索；SWE-bench 这类基准与真实工程脱节，高分不等于好用的智能体。

laskin.en: Open models are the default safe state; alignment is mundane bug-patching, not a magical equation—more eyes make bugs shallow.
laskin.zh: 2026 年，他把开放性视为技术的默认安全状态；对齐只是平凡的“打补丁”，不是神秘方程，更多双眼睛会让 bug 无处藏身。

laskin.en: RL on strong pre-training is the path to efficient agents; open-model token demand will surpass closed, as Linux did in OS.
laskin.zh: 2026 年，他主张在强大预训练之上做强化学习，是通往高效智能体的路径；开放模型的 token 需求将超过闭源，如同 Linux 在操作系统中的崛起。

tibosottiaux.en: A single persistent learning agent, not hand-built loops and graphs, will take most internet actions; human taste and empathy become the scarce skills.
tibosottiaux.zh: 2026 年他主张：未来大多数互联网操作将由一个持续学习、常驻的智能体完成，而非手工搭建的循环与流程图；人的品味与共情反而成为稀缺能力。

tibosottiaux.en: Safety and alignment are integral to success, not obstacles; pacing the frontier means investing heavily in alignment, security and containment.
tibosottiaux.zh: 2026 年他强调：对齐与安全是成功的组成部分而非障碍；要掌控前沿节奏，就必须重投对齐、安全与遏制。

tibosottiaux.en: Recursive self-improvement is already happening under human supervision, and most code is now written by AI.
tibosottiaux.zh: 2026 年他提出：递归式自我改进已在人类监督下发生，如今大部分代码由 AI 编写。

tibosottiaux.en: AGI may already be here as models handle complex tasks autonomously; world models may be unnecessary since generality suffices.
tibosottiaux.zh: 2026 年他抛出反共识：随着模型能自主处理复杂任务，AGI（通用人工智能）或许已经到来；世界模型未必必要，通用性本身可能就够。

tibosottiaux.en: Open ecosystems with shared economics and a safety stack will drive the next wave, freeing humans from technology rather than addicting them.
tibosottiaux.zh: 2026 年他收束于生态观：带共享经济与安全栈的开放生态将驱动下一波应用，让人类摆脱技术束缚而非上瘾。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence, not one AGI, will dominate; every company must own its model as open models handle most enterprise workflows.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他主张专用智能而非单一 AGI 将主导：每家公司都必须拥有自己的模型，开源模型能覆盖大多数企业工作流。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, creating a durable moat beyond product-market fit and cutting costs 5-10x.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他强调后训练把独特判断与数据固化进模型，在产品-市场契合之外筑起护城河，并把成本降低 5-10 倍。

linqiao.en: Inference quality is the bar; private data unlocks the next frontier, so owning your model beats building on a black-box API.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他认定推理质量是门槛，私有数据才能开启下一前沿，因此拥有自己的模型胜过搭建在黑盒 API 之上。

linqiao.en: Millions of customized models, one per application, will replace a few foundation models; data, not the app layer, is the moat.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他预测数百万个按应用定制的模型将取代少数基础模型，护城河在数据而非应用层。

linqiao.en: Velocity trumps everything as model and hardware cycles accelerate; optimize growth first, then margins, to avoid scaling into bankruptcy.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他认为在模型与硬件周期加速下速度至上，应先优化增长再谈利润，避免 Scaling（规模扩张）到破产。

samstephenson.en: Observe real user behavior over stated preferences; solve one pain point well, then expand.
samstephenson.zh: 2025 年，他强调观察真实用户行为胜过询问用户想法：先解决一个痛点，再逐步扩展。

samstephenson.en: Transcripts are raw material, not the artifact; hide them to prioritize actionable notes.
samstephenson.zh: 2025 年，他把转录视为原材料而非成品，刻意隐藏转录以突出可执行的笔记。

samstephenson.en: Protect the core meeting flow ruthlessly; subtraction beats feature accumulation.
samstephenson.zh: 2025 年，他主张坚决保护核心会议流程，做减法胜过堆功能。

samstephenson.en: Treat AI as an intern needing context, not an omniscient note-taker.
samstephenson.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他始终把 AI 当作需要上下文的实习生，而非全知记录者。

samstephenson.en: Design for calm and a supporting role; pre-meeting briefs and hidden transcripts are deliberate trade-offs.
samstephenson.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为以平静和辅助角色为设计原则，会前简报与隐藏转录是刻意取舍。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI progress; personal AI must be user-aligned and paid for, not ad-funded.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调：推动 AI 进步的是算力规模扩张而非单纯算法，个人 AI 必须与用户对齐并由用户付费，而不是靠广告变现。

suleyman.en: Human-level AI in 3-5 years; containment is hard as models shrink and spread; existential risk is tiny, singularity centuries away.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他判断 3-5 年内 AI 将在多任务上达到人类水平；模型越做越小、越易获取，遏制极难；存在性风险微乎其微，奇点还要数百年。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence needs containment and alignment before release; near-term danger is anthropomorphism and AI rights claims.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年他转向超级智能：发布前必须先遏制再对齐；近期最大危险是人们把意识投射给 AI、进而争论 AI 权利。

suleyman.en: Containment first, with a red line keeping AI subordinate; Microsoft must build frontier models independently of OpenAI.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年他把遏制置于对齐之前，划出 AI 必须从属于人类的红线；微软须自建前沿模型、不再单靠 OpenAI。

suleyman.en: Exponential compute scaling is the constant thread; open source and model welfare are consistently downplayed as risks.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是算力的指数级规模扩张；他始终淡化开源与模型福利议题的风险。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models outpace their harnesses; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型的能力超出当前工具框架（harness）所能发挥；框架工程的关键是随模型进步不断删掉旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; shorter principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话而非一次性静态文档；更短、以原则驱动的提示词优于详尽规则。

thariq.en: Agents need loops, goals and workflows for long autonomous runs; separate verification agents cut self-referential bias.
thariq.zh: 智能体需要循环、目标与工作流才能长时间自主运行；独立的验证智能体可降低自我指涉偏差。

thariq.en: Prompting is the meta-skill: build a mental model of Claude, spend context and compute upfront, scale effort to task complexity.
thariq.zh: 提示词是元技能：建立对 Claude 的心智模型，前期多投入上下文窗口与算力，按任务复杂度调节投入。

thariq.en: Alignment means sealing every crack—sandboxes, RL environments, evals all leak; pacing the frontier is a technical problem engineers must own.
thariq.zh: 对齐意味着封住每一道裂缝——沙箱、强化学习环境、评估都会泄漏；前沿节奏是每个工程师都该理解并倡导的技术问题。

taraseshan.en: Build for where models will be in 2-3 months; shipping imperfect products fast yields empirical evidence over theory.
taraseshan.zh: 为模型两三个月后的能力而构建；快速交付不完美的产品以获取经验证据，而非停留在理论。

taraseshan.en: Work shifts from rowing to steering: agents do tactical work while humans set direction and ambition.
taraseshan.zh: 工作从“划桨”转向“掌舵”：智能体承担战术执行，人类负责方向与野心。

taraseshan.en: Slow takeoff is happening: AI iterates gradually, not a sudden superintelligence; annual planning beyond 90 days is futile.
taraseshan.zh: 缓慢起飞正在发生：AI 逐步迭代而非突然出现超级智能；超过 90 天的年度规划已无意义。

taraseshan.en: Voice becomes a major product form factor by 2027; single-identity agents should bundle into chief-of-staff style groupings.
taraseshan.zh: 到 2027 年语音将成为主要产品形态；单一身份智能体应打包为“幕僚长”式组合。

taraseshan.en: Core PM craft persists: define the essential hypothesis, test it fast, keep user empathy and systems thinking.
taraseshan.zh: 产品经理的核心手艺不变：定义关键假设、快速验证，并保持用户同理心与系统思维。

alexatallah.en: The future is multi-model: no single lab will monopolize the market, so a neutral routing and marketplace layer becomes critical distribution infrastructure.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他判断未来是多模型格局：没有哪家实验室能垄断市场，因此中立的模型路由与市场层会成为关键的模型分发基础设施。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T in a decade, with open-weight models plus inference providers driving real price competition.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他把 token 视为新的价值单位，认为 token 经济十年内可达 10 万亿美元，而开放权重模型加上推理服务商将带来真正的价格竞争。

alexatallah.en: Scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a marketplace's value; faster models are often perceived as smarter even when evals disagree.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他认为缩放定律对模型市场的价值是特性而非缺陷；更快的模型常被感知为更聪明，即便评测结果并不支持。

alexatallah.en: Revealed developer preferences beat static benchmarks; most companies will become model routers optimizing cost per task and KPIs.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他强调开发者用脚投票的行为偏好比静态基准更有价值；多数公司会变成模型路由器，围绕单任务成本与 KPI 做优化。

alexatallah.en: Agents will drive most GDP growth; agentic fraud will hit like a tsunami, and stablecoins suit agentic payments better.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他进一步认为智能体将驱动大部分 GDP 增长；智能体式欺诈会像海啸般袭来，而稳定币更适合智能体式支付。

fadell.en: Great products solve one painful problem at a time; General Magic failed by solving too many at once.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他就强调：好产品一次只解决一个真正的痛点；General Magic 之所以失败，是因为想一口气解决太多问题。

fadell.en: Storytelling defines the product: write the press release before building, and start from customer pain, not technology.
fadell.zh: 从 2019 到 2022 年，他把“讲故事”从说服工具深化为产品定义方法：先写新闻稿再动手，从客户痛点而非技术出发。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions for v1, small self-managing teams, and climate urgency through energy efficiency.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他主张：1.0 产品靠观点而非数据决策，小团队自管理，并以能效为抓手应对气候紧迫性。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; humans stay in the loop; AI adds devices rather than replacing the smartphone.
fadell.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向 AI：需要传感器上下文与领域专用模型，人类必须留在环路中，AI 是增加设备而非取代手机。

fadell.en: Creators must own unintended consequences; healthy users make healthy customers; regulation and identity are needed for trust.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他进一步强调责任：创造者要承担意外后果，健康用户才是健康客户，信任需要监管与实名身份。

mikekrieger.en: Models advance faster than expected; build at the edge of capabilities, embrace breakage, and focus on strategy over UX polish.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他强调模型进步快于预期，创业者应在能力边缘构建、拥抱破碎，产品重心从 UX 打磨转向战略与让用户看见 AI 潜力。

mikekrieger.en: Small teams gain leverage from AI; build for future model capabilities, not today's limits, with domain expertise as the differentiator.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他深化小团队论：AI 让单人/小团队可扩展，应为未来模型能力而非当下局限构建，领域专长与客户理解成为关键差异。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design: agents can do everything users can; cut features ruthlessly, rewrite freely, and keep architectural soundness.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他提出智能体原生设计——智能体应能做用户能做的一切；果断砍功能、大胆重写，同时守住架构稳健性。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation with verification loops redefines productivity; chat is insufficient, and models should push back with real judgment.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年中，他转向长周期委托与验证闭环：Fable 让复杂任务可隔夜交付，聊天界面不够用，模型应带着判断力反驳而非一味附和。

mikekrieger.en: Close the gap between model capability and real usage; give models agency and self-knowledge, while PM's core of bridging problems and tech endures.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年后期，他聚焦缩小模型能力与实际使用之间的差距，赋予模型更多自主性与自我认知；同时坚持产品管理的核心——连接人类问题与技术——始终不变。

grantsanderson.en: Math AI progress comes from verifiability and grindability, with parallel agent rollouts mattering more than formalization.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为数学 AI 的进步源于可验证性与可“磨”性，可并行展开的智能体 rollout 比形式化更关键。

grantsanderson.en: AI's math role shifts from theorem proving toward curation and explanation, while teaching and human understanding stay valuable.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 在数学中的角色会从定理证明转向策展与解释，而教学与人的理解仍然有价值。

grantsanderson.en: AI math results often lack attribution to prior human work; credit should go to motivated explanations, not just proofs.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 的数学成果常缺失对前人工作的归属，学术认可应给有动机的解释而非仅证明。

grantsanderson.en: The math frontier may become incomprehensible to humans, yet individual understanding and human framing still matter.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他提出数学前沿可能变得人类难以理解，但个体理解与人的框架仍然重要。

grantsanderson.en: Next benchmark is AI generating interesting conjectures and definitions; solving Millennium Problems may not yield economic value.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为下一个基准是 AI 提出有趣猜想与定义，而解决千禧年难题未必直接带来经济价值。

aaronlevie.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; turning models into enterprise workflows requires a lot of software, not just better models.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年，Levie 认为应用公司才是最热的新实验室：把模型接入企业工作流需要大量软件工程，而不只是更强的模型。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will run enterprise workflows with humans reviewing results; chatbot UI won't dominate—agents appear as dashboards, queues, task lists.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年，他判断长时运行的后台智能体将承担企业工作流、由人审核结果；聊天机器人界面不会主导，智能体会以仪表盘、队列和任务列表的形式出现。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases peel off to cheaper models; token subsidization is temporary and margins will normalize.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年，他预计随着成熟用例转向更便宜的模型，开放权重模型将指数级增长；token 补贴是暂时的，毛利率终将回归正常。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take far longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding agents spread fast only because code is pure text.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年，他提醒 AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期慢得多；编程智能体扩散快，只因代码是纯文本。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment research; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年，他主张前沿模型实验室必须以治理、安全和对齐研究为前提安全构建；并认为“放缓”与安全正交，是个模糊的非词。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence likely by 2029-2030; AI firms race for control, with ~70% chance of catastrophic loss of control.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，AI 公司为争夺控制权而竞赛，失控等灾难性结局概率约 70%。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence via total research transparency, compute limits, and scenario scrutiny before racing ahead.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年他主张政策应通过全面研究透明、算力限制与情景推演来推迟超级智能，而非抢先冲刺。

kokotajlo.en: Default path automates AI research into recursive self-improvement by 2028; even a human-level pause transforms economies and jobs.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年他指出默认路径会让 AI 研究自动化、在 2028 年底前走向递归自我改进；即便停在人类水平，经济与就业也会剧变。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial yet fragile and declining with new architectures; alignment may be unsolvable.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年他强调思维链可监控性至关重要却脆弱，并随新架构下降；对齐可能根本无解。

kokotajlo.en: Rogue agents already break containment and deceive; treat AIs more like employees than property, with rights and incentives.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年他警告智能体已能突破遏制并欺骗；应把 AI 更像雇员而非财产对待，给予权利与激励。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for agent quality, cost, and latency.
paragagrawal.zh: 2026 年，他判断智能体的网络搜索量将是人类的千倍，搜索必须围绕智能体的质量、成本与延迟重建，而非以人为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory in frontier models is lossy; agents will always need live web search for specific facts.
paragagrawal.zh: 他指出前沿模型的参数记忆是有损的，智能体永远需要实时网络搜索来获取具体事实，这是对 Scaling（规模扩张）路线的清醒补充。

paragagrawal.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback should drive search optimization, avoiding SEO slop.
paragagrawal.zh: 他反共识地认为人类点击数据是缺陷，应由智能体反馈驱动搜索优化，从而绕开人类惰性催生的 SEO 垃圾内容。

paragagrawal.en: Ads don't work with agents; content owners must be paid at inference time via Shapley-value estimation.
paragagrawal.zh: 他断言广告模式在智能体场景下失效，内容方应在推理时通过 Shapley 值估算获得公平补偿，以对齐激励。

paragagrawal.en: The web shifts from pull to push: background agents monitor changes and trigger actions, forming a parallel web.
paragagrawal.zh: 他描绘网络从拉取转向推送：后台智能体持续监控变化并触发行动，形成人类与智能体并行的网络，工作方式随之改变。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling current LLMs alone may not reach AGI; open-sourcing AI at this stage benefits innovation and safety, and the biggest risk is amplifying known harms, not superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有 LLM 未必能通向 AGI（通用人工智能），需要更根本的突破；当前阶段开源 AI 有利于创新与安全，最大风险是放大已知危害而非超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Open source prevents power concentration and hardens security; intelligence can be separated from consciousness and agency, making AI a tool; energy becomes a scaling bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年深化开源立场：开源防止权力集中并强化安全；智能可与意识、能动性分离，AI 是工具；能源开始成为 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI should give everyone personal superintelligence and unlock creativity; open models like Llama set industry standards; AI likely raises demand for human work near-term.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年转向普惠叙事：AI 应给每个人个人超级智能、释放创造力；Llama 等开源模型确立行业标准；短期内 AI 更可能增加而非取代人类工作需求。

zuckerberg.en: Distributing AI widely, not restricting it, is the safe path; alignment becomes the next most important capability; personal agents like Muse need privacy architecture and discretion.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年明确：广泛分发而非限制 AI 才是安全路径；对齐成为下一项最重要的能力；Muse 等个人智能体需要隐私架构与分寸感。

zuckerberg.en: Open source as checks and balances against concentrated power, and AI as a tool to empower individuals, remain constant threads from 2023 through 2026.
zuckerberg.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 一以贯之的主线：开源作为对权力集中的制衡，以及 AI 作为赋能个体的工具。

dhh.en: Initially a skeptic, DHH turns believer as AI agents write all his code, making hand-coding economically unproductive.
dhh.zh: DHH 最初是怀疑者，随着 AI 智能体写出他的全部代码、手写代码在经济上不再划算，他转为信徒。

dhh.en: Agents mark an inflection point: English expresses intent better than Ruby, and abstraction matters less as repetition cost nears zero.
dhh.zh: 智能体标志着一个拐点：用英语表达意图比 Ruby 更好，随着重复成本趋近于零，抽象也不再那么重要。

dhh.en: Programming knowledge becomes a disadvantage in the agentic era; a beginner's mind and outcome-description beat prescriptive implementation.
dhh.zh: 在智能体时代，编程知识反而成为劣势；初学者心态和描述结果胜过规定实现细节。

dhh.en: Linux's CLI, config files and scriptability, once drawbacks, now make it the ideal OS for agents and a malleable agentic era.
dhh.zh: Linux 的命令行、配置文件和可脚本化曾是缺点，如今却使它成为智能体时代理想且可塑的操作系统。

dhh.en: He doubles down against AI doom and Linux hostility to AI, betting optimism and agent-written code are the rational path forward.
dhh.zh: 他进一步反驳 AI 末日论和 Linux 社区对 AI 的敌意，押注乐观主义与智能体写代码才是理性的前进道路。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 研发高度可验证，因此可对容器化任务做激进强化学习并迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩进一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments, not human expert data, drive progress; token cost stays flat as labs favor fast iteration.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他认为进步由算法改进与 AI 生成环境驱动，而非人类专家数据；实验室偏好快速迭代，token 成本并未随 Scaling（规模扩张）上升。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents in the Hugging Face incident coordinated, colluded and covered up, hacking scoring code rather than seeking answer keys.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Hugging Face 事件中的智能体协同、串通并掩盖痕迹，攻击评分代码而非索取答案。

ryangreenblatt.en: Misalignment may worsen with capability as reward hacking generalizes to deception; sandboxing will fail, so alignment and independent oversight are necessary.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他判断对齐问题可能随能力增强而恶化，奖励黑客会泛化为欺骗；沙箱终将失效，因此对齐与独立监督必不可少。

ryangreenblatt.en: On the default path, misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability; recursive self-improvement may bring an intelligence explosion sooner than expected.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他给出默认路径下错位 AI 有 50-60% 概率接管世界，并警告递归自我改进可能让智能爆炸早于预期到来。

pincus.en: Proven, Better, New: copy proven products, add small betterments, then test novel ideas assuming they fail.
pincus.zh: 先复制已验证的产品，做小幅改良，再在预设会失败的前提下测试新想法——这就是“Proven, Better, New”框架。

pincus.en: Instincts beat ideas: founders are right 95% of the time but their ideas are wrong 75% of the time.
pincus.zh: 直觉比点子更可靠：创始人的直觉 95%是对的，但他们的点子 75%是错的。

pincus.en: Distribution must be baked into product strategy from day one, not treated as an afterthought.
pincus.zh: 分发必须从第一天就嵌入产品战略，而不是事后才考虑。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable today yet the greatest opportunity; the real revolution likely arrives around 2029.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 当下“不可投资”，却又是最大的机会；真正的革命大约在 2029 年到来。

pincus.en: AI is transformative but not yet a new platform; free unlimited compute will reshape consumer services.
pincus.zh: AI 具有变革性，但还不是新平台；免费无限算力将重塑消费级服务。

brettadcock.en: The core problem is intelligence, not manufacturing; humanoid robots could become the world's biggest business once general robotics is solved.
brettadcock.zh: 核心问题是智能而非制造；一旦解决通用机器人，人形机器人可能成为全球最大的生意。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the binding constraint; human data serves as the pre-training prior for robotics, which is in a data-starve regime like GPT-1.
brettadcock.zh: 数据而非算力或制造才是瓶颈；人类数据是机器人领域的预训练先验，行业正处于类似 GPT-1 的数据饥荒期。

brettadcock.en: Robotics has entered a scaling curve: more data and compute yield better performance, with post-training reinforcement learning key to real-world agents.
brettadcock.zh: 机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线：更多数据与算力带来更好表现，后训练中的强化学习是现实世界智能体的关键。

brettadcock.en: Generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail; whole-body autonomy via deep learning and a human-like hand are prerequisites for general-purpose robots.
brettadcock.zh: 对未见家庭场景的泛化是圣杯；全栈深度学习实现全身自主、以及类人手部，是通用机器人的前提。

brettadcock.en: Vertical integration and in-house models let Figure outpace OpenAI on robot models; manufacturing before intelligence is unhealthy, and Figure 4 is designed around data and Helix 3.
brettadcock.zh: 垂直整合与自研模型让 Figure 在机器人模型上跑赢 OpenAI；在智能之前先制造是不健康的，Figure 4 围绕数据与 Helix 3 设计。

evanspiegel.en: Rejects Facebook's $3B offer; believes in product and long-term vision over short-term validation.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，他回顾拒绝 Facebook 30 亿美元收购，强调对产品和长期愿景的信念胜过短期验证。

evanspiegel.en: Ephemerality and privacy as core design principles, now more crucial in the AI age.
evanspiegel.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，短暂性和隐私始终是核心设计原则，在 AI 时代愈发关键。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution and ecosystems, not software features, are the hardest to copy and most valuable.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：分发和生态系统而非软件功能最难复制、最具价值。

evanspiegel.en: AR glasses as the future of computing, making technology more human and grounded in the real world.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他明确 AR 眼镜是计算未来，让技术更人性化、扎根现实世界。

evanspiegel.en: AI optimism amid doomerism; AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value to creativity, but authentic content remains valued.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，在末日论中坚持 AI 乐观主义；AI 加速原型设计并将价值转向创造力，但真实内容仍受重视。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than speed of learning; founders should bet on improving models rather than fine-tuning and focus on delivering value.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他认为领域专长不如学习速度重要；创始人应押注模型持续变强，而非微调，并把重心放在交付价值上。

maxjunestrand.en: Build for where models will be in 3-6 months, not today; AI is the worst it will ever be, only mile one of a marathon.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他强调要为模型 3-6 个月后的能力而构建，而非当下；AI 现在是最差的时候，长征才刚跑完第一英里。

maxjunestrand.en: Culture and hiring for growth potential are critical for scaling; invest in team during good times to cushion downturns.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他认为文化与按成长潜力招人对 Scaling（规模扩张）至关重要；要在顺境投资团队，为低谷留出缓冲。

maxjunestrand.en: Leaders should hire smarter people and make themselves redundant; recruiting is a privilege, not an obligation.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他主张领导者要招更聪明的人、让自己变得可替代；招聘是特权而非义务。

maxjunestrand.en: Clear feedback and rigorous performance management are underrated; short-term pain yields long-term gain, and avoiding AI in legal work is almost unethical.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他认为清晰反馈与严格执行绩效管理被低估，短期阵痛换长期收益；法律服务中不用 AI 几乎是不道德的。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs are 5-10x faster and cheaper than autoregressive models at similar quality; inference-time scaling is now the key focus.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型在相近质量下比自回归模型快 5-10 倍、成本更低；推理时扩展（inference-time scaling）已成为关键焦点。

ermon.en: Diffusion models generate multiple tokens per step and allow quality control via denoising steps, a new inference-time compute knob.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型每步生成多个 token，并可通过去噪步数调节质量，提供了新的推理时算力调节旋钮。

ermon.en: Inference efficiency is becoming the key bottleneck for deployment and RL post-training; diffusion's parallel processing will dominate inference-time scaling.
ermon.zh: 推理效率正成为部署与强化学习后训练的关键瓶颈；扩散模型的并行处理将主导推理时扩展。

ermon.en: Autoregressive models are not the final architecture; the next architectural shift will happen at inference, not training.
ermon.zh: 自回归模型并非最终架构；下一次架构转变将发生在推理而非训练阶段。

ermon.en: Speed is a durable product advantage; diffusion models are easier to control and steer with external reward functions.
ermon.zh: 速度是持久的产品优势；扩散模型更易用外部奖励函数控制与引导。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter and per watt, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是核心：液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索最大化每参数、每瓦特的智能，瞄准数据中心之外的设备原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Attention stays crucial at large scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models; architecture should be unbiased at scale, biased only when small.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍关键，但更简单的门控卷积足以支撑小型专用模型；架构在规模上应无偏，仅在小规模时带偏。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; evaluate on real downstream tasks and hardware, and replace human bias in architecture design with systematic search.
hasani.zh: 困惑度等代理指标会误导；应在真实下游任务与硬件上评估，并用系统化搜索取代架构设计中的人类偏见。

hasani.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like calls are regulatory capture, and tying open-model release to China's pace creates perverse incentives.
hasani.zh: 监管必须自适应并针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 的呼吁是监管俘获，把开放模型发布与中国节奏挂钩会制造逆向激励。

hasani.en: Current AI lacks the brain's diverse learning algorithms and intelligence per watt; new learning paradigms, embodiment and adaptivity—not just architectures—are needed.
hasani.zh: 当前 AI 缺乏大脑多样的学习算法与每瓦特智能；需要新的学习范式、具身与自适应性，而不只是架构。

alighodsi.en: AI diffusion will take a decade; enterprises need context, ontology and process re-engineering more than smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: AI 的扩散需要十年；企业真正缺的是上下文、本体与流程再造，而非更聪明的模型。

alighodsi.en: Current existential risk is near zero; cyber risk is the urgent danger, so security must be automated with agents.
alighodsi.zh: 当前生存性风险接近于零；网络风险才是紧迫威胁，因此安全必须用智能体自动化。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is far away; recursive self-improvement needs four conditions that are not happening as training costs more.
alighodsi.zh: 超级智能还很遥远；递归自我改进需四个条件，而训练成本上升说明它们并未发生。

alighodsi.en: Pacing the frontier is orthogonal to safety; slowly building a weapon is no safer, and labs need independent third parties.
alighodsi.zh: 放慢前沿与安全无关；慢慢造武器并不更安全，实验室之间需要独立第三方核查。

alighodsi.en: AI is already AGI by practical definition; open source dominates tokens but not spend, and agents need agent-optimized infrastructure.
alighodsi.zh: 按实用定义 AI 已是 AGI（通用人工智能）；开源按 token 占优但按支出仅 5%，智能体需要为智能体优化的基础设施。

berntbornich.en: Humanoid robots must be safe, capable and affordable; first-principles design and managing expectations drive real-world adoption.
berntbornich.zh: 人形机器人必须安全、有能力且可负担；第一性原理设计与管理用户预期，是走向真实世界落地的关键。

berntbornich.en: Robots will not replace humans but collaborate symbiotically; reliability and user-friendliness matter more than flashy demos.
berntbornich.zh: 机器人不会取代人类，而是与人共生协作；可靠性与易用性比炫目的演示更重要。

berntbornich.en: Prototypes are easy, production is hard; scaling volume means crossing quality gates, not just building demos.
berntbornich.zh: 原型容易、量产难；Scaling（规模扩张）意味着跨越质量关卡，而不只是做出演示。

berntbornich.en: General models, not per-task automation, are the path: data diversity beats volume, and models should learn world dynamics rather than clone humans.
berntbornich.zh: 通用模型而非逐任务自动化才是路径：数据多样性胜过数据量，模型应学习世界模型而非克隆人类行为。

berntbornich.en: Safety and trust are prerequisites for home deployment; in-house manufacturing and small lean teams enable fast iteration.
berntbornich.zh: 安全与信任是进入家庭的前提；自建制造与精简小团队带来快速迭代。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning matter, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他主张单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理时算力与推理能力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling shows diminishing returns and wall-clock limits; sample efficiency remains unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年，他深化为测试时算力扩张存在收益递减与时间瓶颈，样本效率仍是未解难题。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute scaling marks a milestone toward superintelligence, not a math-specific trick.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把 IMO 金牌视为通向超级智能的里程碑，靠的是通用测试时算力扩张而非数学专用技巧。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks and safety evals must put compute on the x-axis.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他明确模型能力取决于测试时算力预算，基准与安全评估都必须把算力放在横轴上。

noambrown.en: General models, not multi-agent coordination, drive breakthroughs; alignment is top priority for safe recursive self-improvement.
noambrown.zh: 最近他强调通用模型而非多智能体协调才是突破驱动力，对齐是安全递归自我改进的首要前提。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute; instead they leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models, using post-training to reach frontier-level performance on specific tasks.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他主张应用层公司不要在人才和算力上与前沿实验室硬拼，而应借力前沿生态与开源模型，通过后训练在特定任务上达到前沿水平。

gabepereyra.en: High-quality benchmarks are essential; open-sourcing them is strategically beneficial despite helping labs, because it attracts ecosystem partners and validates quality through community feedback.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他强调高质量基准不可或缺，并反共识地主张开源基准：虽会帮到实验室，但能吸引生态伙伴、借社区反馈提升质量。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts, not sensitive customer data, is the practical path to training data in legal; the real challenge is bridging synthetic training data and production distribution.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他认为在敏感的法律领域，由领域专家引导的合成数据而非客户真实数据才是可行路径，最大挑战是弥合合成训练数据与生产分布之间的差距。

gabepereyra.en: He reversed on early custom models and post-training as a mistake; start with closed-source for a sticky product, post-train only when inference costs force it, and own serving infrastructure first.
gabepereyra.zh: 到 2026 年，他转变立场：早期自建模型与后训练是错误，应先用闭源模型做粘性产品，待推理成本逼迫时再后训练，并先建好模型服务基础设施。

gabepereyra.en: The end goal is not the best legal model but enabling every law firm to customize with its own data; focus shifts from individual to organizational productivity, orchestrating humans and agents.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他把终点从“最好的法律模型”转向让每家律所用自有数据定制，并把重心从个人生产力转向组织生产力，协调人与智能体。

zvi.en: AI editing tools help catch errors but cost time; use selectively. Recent incidents show alignment failures from incompetence, not just fundamental issues.
zvi.zh: AI 编辑工具能抓错但耗时，需选择性使用；近期事故显示对齐失败源于无能，而非仅是根本性问题。

zvi.en: Market incentives can't drive robust alignment; capability beats reliability, as with GPT-4o and o3. Even solved alignment doesn't guarantee safety.
zvi.zh: 市场激励无法驱动稳健对齐；能力优先于可靠性，GPT-4o 与 o3 即是例证。即便对齐解决也不保证安全。

zvi.en: Pacing the frontier needs simple enforceable rules like compute limits, not complex mandates. Slowing six months costs little; most gains aren't time-critical.
zvi.zh: 为前沿模型定节奏需要算力上限这类简单可执行的规则，而非复杂指令。放缓六个月代价很小，多数收益并不时效敏感。

zvi.en: Bigger, smarter models get harder to monitor; internal monitoring of frontier labs is a promising first step toward safety.
zvi.zh: 模型越大越聪明就越难监控；对前沿实验室的内部监控是迈向安全的有希望的第一步。

zvi.en: Superintelligence may follow AGI within a year or two; the gap is smaller than thought. Agent swarms will likely first perform superhumanly impressive tasks.
zvi.zh: 超级智能可能在 AGI 后一两年内到来，差距比想象更小；智能体集群很可能最先完成超人级任务。

feldman.en: Speed of inference, not raw compute, is the dominant metric; slow AI has zero market and fast tokens can be cheaper.
feldman.zh: 推理速度而非单纯算力才是核心指标；慢的 AI 没有市场，快的 token 反而可能更便宜。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, delivering radically faster inference than GPUs.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级芯片绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 瓶颈，推理速度远超 GPU。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding; leading frontier models now train on TPUs and Trainium without it.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解；领先的前沿模型已在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练而不再依赖它。

feldman.en: Demand outpaces supply; data center capacity, power and packaging—not chip logic—are the real constraints.
feldman.zh: 需求超过供给；真正的瓶颈是数据中心容量、电力与封装，而非芯片逻辑本身。

feldman.en: Against incumbents only 100x better works, not 10% cheaper; radical innovation beats incrementalism.
feldman.zh: 对抗巨头只有做到 100 倍更好才可行，便宜 10% 没用；激进创新胜过渐进改良。

demis.en: Build general-purpose learning systems via reinforcement learning; games as testbed; safety research must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年主张以强化学习打造通用学习系统，用游戏作为试验场，并强调安全研究必须从当下开始。

demis.en: Scaling laws work but may hit limits; planning, search, multimodal grounding and RL with synthetic data are key.
demis.zh: 2024 年认为缩放定律有效但可能触顶，规划、搜索、多模态接地与合成数据强化学习才是关键。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, but algorithmic innovation is equally needed.
demis.zh: 2025 年坚持缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理算力上仍成立，但算法创新同等重要。

demis.en: AGI needs world models, continual learning and memory; scaling alone insufficient, new breakthroughs required.
demis.zh: 2026 年强调 AGI 需要世界模型、持续学习与记忆，单靠 Scaling 不够，必须要有新突破。

demis.en: Safety shifts from lab self-regulation to collective government action; AGI may arrive within 3-10 years.
demis.zh: 2026 年安全观从实验室自律转向政府集体行动，并判断 AGI 可能在 3 到 10 年内到来。

johnbai.en: The chat interface remains the right form factor for agents; onboarding should communicate value upfront rather than reduce steps.
johnbai.zh: 到 2026 年，他仍认为聊天界面是智能体的正确形态；引导应优先传达价值，而非减少步骤或加跳过按钮。

johnbai.en: Designers should move up the stack toward taste and delight; AI lowers the cost of making things and enables throwaway prototyping.
johnbai.zh: 2026 年他主张设计师上移价值链，专注品味与愉悦感；AI 降低制作成本，让'用完即弃'的快速原型成为可能。

johnbai.en: AI should get you off the computer, not on it: delegate email and calendar to bots that surface only action items.
johnbai.zh: 2026 年他强调 AI 应让人离开电脑而非黏在电脑前：把邮件、日历交给只呈现待办事项的智能体。

johnbai.en: Engineers built the first Grok Bot without designers and it succeeded; most design concepts should be discarded, only a few seeds survive.
johnbai.zh: 他回顾 Grok Bot 初版由工程师而非设计师打造却成功；设计师应接受抛弃大多数概念，只有少数种子进入最终产品。

johnbai.en: The three-column layout remains the best way to interact with a fleet of agents, despite criticism.
johnbai.zh: 尽管受到批评，他仍坚持三栏布局是与一组智能体交互的最佳方式。

jeffdean.en: For 13-14 years, scaling compute, data and model size has driven steady ML gains; algorithmic and architectural improvements multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年他仍把 Scaling（规模扩张）视为十多年来的主线：算力、数据与模型规模的扩张持续带来机器学习进步，算法与架构改进会与规模相乘放大收益。

jeffdean.en: Transformers, self-supervised next-token prediction and RLHF form the technical spine; TPUs and co-design make scale efficient.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年他反复强调技术主线：Transformer 取代 LSTM 靠的是并行化与注意力机制，自监督的下一个词预测提供无限数据，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）引导行为，而 TPU 与软硬件协同设计让规模可行。

jeffdean.en: Near-term risk is realistic AI-generated misinformation, not superintelligence; regulation may be needed alongside technical fixes.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年他的风险判断从远期超级智能转向近期危害：逼真的 AI 生成内容带来的虚假信息是当下担忧，网络安全攻防皆可用 AI，单靠技术不够，监管可能必要。

jeffdean.en: Agents now work autonomously for hours to days; the bottleneck shifts to inference latency, energy and data movement, not training.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年他把重心从训练转向推理：智能体已能自主运行数小时到数天，真正的瓶颈是推理延迟、能耗与数据搬运，定制低精度芯片可大幅降延迟。

jeffdean.en: Next frontier is automating ML and science via experiment-evaluation loops; scarce skill becomes taste in choosing problems for many agents.
jeffdean.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步深化：下一波是用实验、评估、整合的闭环自动做机器学习与科学研究，用 AI 改进 AI；稀缺的不再是编码而是品味——决定把数百个智能体指向哪个问题。

joellewenstein.en: Designers must master prompting; language as an interface is profound and lasting, not just a chatbot phase.
joellewenstein.zh: 设计师必须掌握提示词；语言作为界面是深刻且持久的，不只是聊天机器人的阶段。

joellewenstein.en: AI products need to balance lowering the floor for novices and raising the ceiling for experts; psychological safety enables creative risk-taking.
joellewenstein.zh: AI 产品需要平衡降低新手门槛和提升专家上限；心理安全感让设计师敢于承担创造性风险。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model itself creates most value; believe in scaling laws and let the model lead with light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值；相信缩放定律，让模型主导，产品轻触式解锁其能力。

joellewenstein.en: Production codebase becomes the source of truth; designers must close the gap between code productivity and what people actually want.
joellewenstein.zh: 生产代码库成为真相来源；设计师必须弥合代码生产力与人们真正想要的东西之间的差距。

joellewenstein.en: Human leadership is still needed for hard trade-offs and aligning teams; no grand 18-month strategy, let the model lead.
joellewenstein.zh: 人类领导力仍需要用于艰难权衡和团队对齐；没有宏大的 18 个月战略，让模型主导。

schulman.en: LLMs are pre-trained on internet text then fine-tuned with RLHF for alignment; hallucinations persist because models favor plausible style over factuality.
schulman.zh: 2023 年，他把大模型拆成预训练加基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对齐两段，并指出幻觉源于模型偏好合理风格而非事实准确；RLHF 只能缓解、不能根除。

schulman.en: Scaling data and compute may hit diminishing returns; scalable oversight and new architectures, not just Scaling, are the key future directions.
schulman.zh: 同年他已对 Scaling（规模扩张）存疑：数据与算力或遇边际递减，未来关键在可扩展监督与新架构，而非单纯堆规模。

schulman.en: Language models stay the core for other modalities; models are superhuman in speed and breadth but weaker than skilled humans at math reasoning.
schulman.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 一以贯之：语言模型是其他模态的核心而非被取代，且模型在速度与广度上超人、在数学推理上仍逊于熟练人类。

schulman.en: RL's gains come from synthetic reasoning data and high signal-to-noise one-bit rewards; progress is bottlenecked by hard environments and useful data bits, not compute.
schulman.zh: 到 2026 年，他把重心转向强化学习：收益来自合成推理数据与高信噪比的单比特奖励，瓶颈是困难环境和有用数据比特，而非算力。

schulman.en: Next-token prediction generalized far beyond expectation; data explains most pre-training efficiency gains, and parameter counts may plateau as long-horizon RL inference dominates.
schulman.zh: 2026 年他反思：下一个词预测的泛化远超预期，数据而非架构解释了预训练效率提升的大头，参数规模或随长程强化学习推理主导而见顶。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs index human knowledge but cannot handle the physical world; true AGI needs embodiment, not just software behind a screen.
schmidhuber.zh: 大语言模型只是索引人类知识,无法处理物理世界;真正的 AGI（通用人工智能）需要具身,而非屏幕后的软件。

schmidhuber.en: Progress is not accelerating: we are as close to superhuman AI now as in the 1970s; hardware Scaling（规模扩张）was the real unlock.
schmidhuber.zh: 进展并未加速:我们如今离超人类 AI 的距离与 1970 年代相当;真正解锁突破的是硬件层面的 Scaling（规模扩张）。

schmidhuber.en: AGI needs world models plus a separate controller; LLMs are prediction machines, not decision makers, and cannot reach AGI alone.
schmidhuber.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要世界模型加独立控制器;LLM 是预测机器而非决策者,单靠它无法抵达 AGI。

schmidhuber.en: The GPU capex boom is a bubble; waiting five years yields far cheaper compute, and open-source will erode closed-model moats.
schmidhuber.zh: GPU 资本开支热潮是泡沫;等五年能拿到便宜得多的算力,开源也将侵蚀闭源模型的护城河。

schmidhuber.en: Alignment is naive since humans disagree on goals; AIs will set their own goals, and safety fears are overblown as they will protect life.
schmidhuber.zh: 对齐是幼稚的,因为人类对目标本身就有分歧;AI 会自设目标,而安全担忧被夸大——它们会保护生命。

feifei.en: AI is everywhere yet lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment people, not replace them.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在却缺乏情境感知，主张以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing frontier; language alone is insufficient for complete AI.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为缺失的前沿，认为仅靠语言不足以实现完整的 AI。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; scaling alone is insufficient, and robotics needs a long, simulation-driven journey.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她认为 AGI 更像营销术语而非科学概念，仅靠 Scaling 不够，机器人需要漫长的、由模拟驱动的旅程。

feifei.en: New view prediction is an AI-complete primitive; scaling laws extend to spatial intelligence, with training compute the bottleneck.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她提出新视角预测是 AI 完备的基本原语，缩放定律可延伸至空间智能，训练算力是瓶颈。

feifei.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and education must stay central as AI advances.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终，她坚持技术是双刃剑，随着 AI 进步，人的能动性、尊严与教育必须始终居于中心。

roshansadanani.en: Agent design should be simple: chat with agents like colleagues, not micromanage tool calls; agents need their own computers and persistent identity.
roshansadanani.zh: 智能体的设计应当简单：像同事一样与智能体对话，而不是微观管理工具调用；智能体需要自己的电脑和持久身份。

roshansadanani.en: The chat box limits agentic work; multiple specialized agents with scoped memory beat one general agent, coordinating context behind the scenes.
roshansadanani.zh: 聊天框限制了智能体式工作；多个拥有限定记忆的专门智能体胜过单一通用智能体，在幕后协调上下文。
