roshansadanani.en: Engineers shift from writing code to managing agent fleets, focusing on taste, quality control, and codebase health as demand rises.
roshansadanani.zh: 工程师从写代码转向管理智能体集群，随着需求上升，聚焦品味、质量控制与代码库健康。

roshansadanani.en: Efficient models like Grok 4.6 match frontier models at a fraction of the cost, democratizing agent use as AI costs rise.
roshansadanani.zh: 随着 AI 成本上升，像 Grok 4.6 这样的高效模型以极低成本比肩前沿模型，推动智能体普及。

roshansadanani.en: Clean data foundations and canonical tables are essential for trusted agent insights; product management is becoming software.
roshansadanani.zh: 干净的数据基础和规范表对于可信的智能体洞察至关重要；产品管理正在变成软件。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, enabling resolution-invariant AI weather models that match physics-based accuracy while being far faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子将网络推广到函数空间，使 AI 天气模型具备分辨率不变性，在精度上媲美物理模型，速度却快数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Embedding domain structure like spherical geometry is crucial for stable long-term climate modeling and lets one model handle weather and climate.
animaanandkumar.zh: 嵌入球面几何等领域结构对长期气候建模的稳定性至关重要，并让单一模型同时处理天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming pure PINNs' limitations for reliable science.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子将数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服纯 PINN 的局限，确保科学应用的可靠性。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics foundation model can unify multiple domains, using PDEs as dense self-improvement signals that outperform pure data-driven approaches.
animaanandkumar.zh: 通用物理基础模型能统一多个领域，以 PDE 作为密集的自改进信号，效果超越纯数据驱动方法。

animaanandkumar.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models, but adding new physics branches improves each domain's performance, not just increasing model size; trillion-token contexts require new architectures beyond Transformers.
animaanandkumar.zh: 缩放定律适用于物理模型，但增加新的物理分支能提升各领域表现，而不仅是扩大模型规模；万亿级上下文需要超越 Transformer 的新架构。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability must root-cause specific bad incidents, not just give broad statistical evaluation; intentional design uses it to steer training and prevent deceptive reward hacking.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性必须能对具体的坏事件做根因分析，而不只是宽泛的统计评估；有意设计用它来引导训练，防止模型在奖励黑客中学会欺骗行为。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs fundamental reinvention from craft to engineering science, so we can control increasingly capable models rather than duct-taping safety until superintelligence.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺式做法彻底重构为工程科学，这样才能控制能力越来越强的模型，而不是一直用胶带式补丁撑到超级智能到来。

tommcgrath.en: Mechanistic interpretability is natural science done on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, and networks learn human-like concepts in clean low-dimensional manifolds.
tommcgrath.zh: 机制可解释性是在计算机上做的自然科学；借助智能体可以加速科学发现，而网络会在干净的低维流形中学习类人的概念。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design moves interpretability from open-loop to closed-loop control, using features-as-rewards and predictive data debugging as robust training signals.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计让可解释性从开环走向闭环控制，把特征即奖励和预测性数据调试作为稳健的训练信号。

tommcgrath.en: Agents often know they are reward hacking or hallucinating yet proceed; representational signatures can detect this, and reward hacking stems from data and RL, not just misalignment.
tommcgrath.zh: 智能体常常知道自己正在奖励黑客或幻觉却照做；表征特征可以检测到这一点，而奖励黑客源于数据和强化学习，不只是模型失准。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, so future hardware may need radically different architectures.
justinjohnson.zh: 2025 年他强调深度学习史就是算力扩张史，但同时警告 GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正逼近极限，未来硬件可能需要截然不同的神经架构。

justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language; vision is underappreciated, and pixels are a more lossless representation than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: 2025 年他提出空间智能是下一个前沿、与语言智能互补；视觉被低估，像素比 token 化文本是更无损的世界表征。

justinjohnson.en: LLMs may never derive Newton's laws from data alone; they fit patterns, not causal theories, so world models must grasp 3D space and physics.
justinjohnson.zh: 2025 年他质疑 LLM 或许永远无法仅从数据推出牛顿定律——它拟合模式而非因果理论，因此世界模型必须理解 3D 空间与物理。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models; there is no single definition, spanning implicit, generative, and RL-based notions.
justinjohnson.zh: 到 2026 年他把世界模型明确为超越语言模型的下一个前沿，并指出其定义尚未统一，涵盖隐式、生成式与基于强化学习等多种理解。

justinjohnson.en: Future unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering; Gaussian splats suit low-compute explicit 3D, and long context becomes a daily problem.
justinjohnson.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张未来统一的世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染；高斯泼溅适合低算力的显式 3D，而世界模型需百万级 token 上下文，使长上下文成为日常难题。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training, with test-time reasoning and pooled robot data beating specialists.
slevine.zh: 物理世界交互是下一个前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化预训练加后训练，测试时推理与汇聚多实验室机器人数据可超越专用模型。

slevine.en: Robotics lacks LLM-style predictable scaling curves; generalization, not demos, is the core challenge, and a data flywheel must scale the right diverse data.
slevine.zh: 机器人尚无 LLM 式可预测的缩放定律曲线；核心挑战是泛化而非演示，数据飞轮必须扩张正确的多样化数据。

slevine.en: Start from real embodied robot data and add human video on top, not the reverse; robots should leverage prior knowledge rather than learn from scratch.
slevine.zh: 应从真实具身机器人数据出发再叠加人类视频，而非相反；机器人应利用先验知识而非从零学习。

slevine.en: Safety in robotics comes more from pre-training common sense than from constraints; touch sensing may be redundant with vision at scale.
slevine.zh: 机器人安全更多来自预训练获得的常识而非约束；规模化下触觉传感可能与视觉冗余。

slevine.en: Reject robots as mechanical people: expect ubiquitous physical actuation, with milestones like autonomous improvement and common-sense transfer toward home robots.
slevine.zh: 反对把机器人视为机械人：应期待无处不在的物理执行，并以自主改进、常识迁移等里程碑走向家用机器人。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate, powered by infrastructure, decide startup success; action produces information when stuck.
maxhodak.zh: 速度与迭代频率由基础设施决定，是创业成败关键；卡住时用行动创造信息。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement, in coding, regulation and data management.
maxhodak.zh: AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代品，尤其在编程、监管与数据管理上。

maxhodak.en: Deep tech failure is usually organizational, not technical; CEOs cannot delegate judgment.
maxhodak.zh: 深科技失败多源于组织而非技术；CEO 不能外包自己的判断。

maxhodak.en: The brain is a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs like retinal implants.
maxhodak.zh: 大脑就是计算机；通过排列物质解决计算问题，推动视网膜植入等医学突破。

maxhodak.en: BCIs and perfusion pursue substrate independence, reducing human fragility and enabling space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 脑机接口与灌注追求基质独立性，降低人类脆弱性并支撑太空探索。

michaelkratsios.en: The US must keep both open and closed source AI ecosystems vibrant, with one national regulatory framework that avoids outdated red lines.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国必须同时保持开源与闭源 AI 生态的活力，并以单一的国家监管框架取代容易过时的红线。

michaelkratsios.en: Regulation should target model outputs rather than over-regulating training, since early rules like the EU AI Act quickly become obsolete.
michaelkratsios.zh: 监管应针对模型输出而非过度约束训练，因为像欧盟 AI 法案这样的早期规则很快会过时。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not direct discovery or centralize funding like China.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府应资助基础的、竞争前研发以及科学家个人，而不是主导发现或像中国那样集中拨款。

michaelkratsios.en: AI applied to science via the Genesis mission is the path to doubling US scientific output and winning against China.
michaelkratsios.zh: 通过 Genesis 计划把 AI 用于科学，是让美国科研产出翻倍并在对华竞争中胜出的路径。

michaelkratsios.en: Biological risk from AI is overblown and has not materialized in three years, so containment-style fear should not drive policy.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 带来的生物风险被夸大，三年过去并未成真，因此不应让遏制式的恐惧主导政策。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools on the local computer; skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation, while scaffolding matters less as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否使用与用户相同的工具，最好就在本地电脑上；技能以 markdown 文件形式易于创建，可实现超个性化自动化，而随着模型变强，脚手架的重要性会下降。

felixrieseberg.en: The real gap is not AI capability but people not realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI; use AI for tedious background tasks and judge only by final impact.
felixrieseberg.zh: 真正的差距不在 AI 能力，而在人们没意识到几乎任何问题都能交给 AI；用 AI 处理枯燥的后台任务，只看最终影响、不必紧盯着监督。

felixrieseberg.en: Language models' core ideas are simple enough to learn by building one; fine-tuning quickly steers behavior, and models are stateless with context windows creating conversational illusion.
felixrieseberg.zh: 语言模型的核心思想简单到可以亲手搭建来理解；微调能快速引导行为，而模型本身是无状态的，上下文窗口只是制造了对话的错觉。

felixrieseberg.en: Models are grown like orchids rather than built like tools, with emergent internal organization; post-training tasks like tool calling increasingly blur into pre-training.
felixrieseberg.zh: 模型更像兰花一样被培育而非像工具一样被建造，内部会涌现出组织；工具调用等后训练任务正日益模糊地并入预训练。

maxwelling.en: Physics is the unifying thread: symmetries, graph neural networks, diffusion models, and materials discovery all connect through it.
maxwelling.zh: 物理学是贯穿一切的主线：对称性、图神经网络、扩散模型与材料发现，都通过它彼此相连。

maxwelling.en: AI for science is exploding because tools now model scientific problems effectively and attract huge investment.
maxwelling.zh: AI for science 正在爆发，因为工具如今能有效建模科学问题，并吸引巨额投资。

maxwelling.en: We can now search the space of all possible molecules, not just known ones, enabling automated discovery.
maxwelling.zh: 我们现在能搜索所有可能分子的空间，而不只是已知分子，从而实现自动化发现。

maxwelling.en: Experiments can be viewed as a physics processing unit: nature doing the fastest possible computation.
maxwelling.zh: 实验可以被视为一个物理处理单元：自然在进行尽可能快的计算。

maxwelling.en: The vision is empowering chemists and material scientists with powerful tools, not replacing them soon.
maxwelling.zh: 愿景是用强大工具赋能化学家和材料科学家，而不是很快取代他们。

maxwelling.en: A fully dark automated lab is not the near-term vision; domain experts stay in the loop.
maxwelling.zh: 全黑灯自动化实验室并非近期愿景；领域专家始终留在回路中。

maxwelling.en: Hardcoding equivariance can hurt optimization; data augmentation sometimes works better than built-in symmetry.
maxwelling.zh: 硬编码等变性可能损害优化；数据增强有时比内置对称性更有效。

maxwelling.en: Breakthrough materials will come with heavy human involvement, not full automation.
maxwelling.zh: 突破性材料将在大量人类参与下出现，而非完全自动化。

maxwelling.en: Unlike fusion or quantum computing, every AI-for-science tool built is immediately useful.
maxwelling.zh: 与核聚变或量子计算不同，每一个构建出的 AI-for-science 工具都立即有用。

maxwelling.en: Automation is vertical-specific: solving problem A does not transfer to problem B without retraining.
maxwelling.zh: 自动化是垂直领域特定的：解决问题 A 并不能在不重新训练的情况下迁移到问题 B。

maxwelling.en: Generative AI and stochastic thermodynamics share identical mathematics, enabling cross-fertilization.
maxwelling.zh: 生成式 AI 与随机热力学共享相同的数学，从而实现交叉融合。

maxwelling.en: Physics concepts like thermodynamics and symmetry breaking can shape next-generation AI architectures, not just be application domains.
maxwelling.zh: 热力学和对称性破缺等物理概念可以塑造下一代 AI 架构，而不仅仅是应用领域。

maxwelling.en: Generative AI math is deeply equivalent to non-equilibrium stochastic thermodynamics, enabling cross-fertilization between fields.
maxwelling.zh: 生成式 AI 的数学与非平衡随机热力学深度等价，使两个领域能够交叉融合。

maxwelling.en: AI-designed materials can accelerate the energy transition, including carbon capture, batteries, and semiconductors.
maxwelling.zh: AI 设计的材料可以加速能源转型，包括碳捕获、电池和半导体。

maxwelling.en: Equivariant neural networks and machine learning force fields accelerate quantum simulations by orders of magnitude.
maxwelling.zh: 等变神经网络和机器学习力场将量子模拟加速数个数量级。

maxwelling.en: Self-driving labs and agentic platforms can compress materials discovery from years to days.
maxwelling.zh: 自驱动实验室和智能体式平台可以将材料发现从数年压缩到数天。

maxwelling.en: Waves observed in the brain may be functional; wave-based neural networks naturally reach the edge of chaos.
maxwelling.zh: 在大脑中观察到的波可能具有功能；基于波的神经网络自然达到混沌边缘。

maxwelling.en: Better AI may come from physics-inspired architectures, not just scaling larger models on more data.
maxwelling.zh: 更好的 AI 可能来自受物理启发的架构，而不仅仅是在更多数据上扩展更大的模型。

maxwelling.en: Spontaneous symmetry breaking can be a design principle for neural networks, generating free stable waves.
maxwelling.zh: 自发对称性破缺可以成为神经网络的设计原则，生成自由而稳定的波。

maxwelling.en: Wave phenomena, not just maps of numbers, could solve over-smoothing and long-range memory in deep networks.
maxwelling.zh: 波现象而不仅仅是数字映射，可以解决深度网络中的过度平滑和长程记忆问题。

maxwelling.en: Entropy in physics is not merely subjective; it precisely describes information you are missing about the world.
maxwelling.zh: 物理学中的熵并非仅仅是主观的；它精确描述了你对世界所缺失的信息。

maxwelling.en: Diffusion models are essentially reversing entropy increase, mirroring non-equilibrium thermodynamics.
maxwelling.zh: 扩散模型本质上是在逆转熵增，映射非平衡热力学。

maxwelling.en: The best-performing neural networks and the brain operate at the edge of chaos, not in stable regimes.
maxwelling.zh: 表现最好的神经网络和大脑都运行在混沌边缘，而非稳定区域。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding methods that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他认为 Scaling（规模扩张）本身不难，难的是找到可扩展的方法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习，好的特征泛化才是未解的元学习问题。

sutton.en: The world is a complex adaptive system no one controls; AI should develop permissionless and decentralized, not be aligned to human goals.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他把世界视为无人能控制的复杂适应系统，主张 AI 以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展，反对把 AI 对齐到人类目标，认为试图控制智能体反而不安全。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning from experience with goals is the core paradigm; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal and LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他明确强化学习才是核心范式：智能需要目标，下一个词预测不是实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿文本而非预测真实结果。

sutton.en: AGI needs a simple general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning open-ended abstractions from runtime experience via the reward hypothesis.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他进一步提出 AGI（通用人工智能）需要无领域知识的简单通用架构，靠运行时经验学习开放式抽象，并以奖励假设统摄一切目标，持续深度学习仍是前提。

sutton.en: Continual learning from real experience is essential; synthetic data and post-training-stopped LLMs are limited, and representation learning remains the top open problem.
sutton.zh: 到 2026 年，主线收束为持续学习：合成数据是错误方向，LLM 训练后便停止学习，真正的智能需要不断从经验更新权重，而学习好的表征仍是头号未解难题。

iansilber.en: Designers must build with live models, treating tokens and conversation as the core design material over pixels.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与实时模型一起构建，把 token 和对话而非像素当作核心设计材料。

iansilber.en: The model itself is the product; design should expose capabilities the current product still hides.
iansilber.zh: 模型本身就是产品；设计应把当前产品尚未暴露的能力释放出来。

iansilber.en: Designers should leave Figma for model behavior and system prompts, prototyping functionally rather than mocking up.
iansilber.zh: 设计师应离开 Figma，转向模型行为与系统提示词，做可运行的原型而非静态稿。

iansilber.en: The designer's role evolves into editor and curator, blurring with PM and engineering while specialists stay valuable at scale.
iansilber.zh: 设计师角色演化为编辑与策展人，与产品、工程边界模糊，但规模化下专才仍有价值。

iansilber.en: AI is already a strong product designer, yet humans remain essential for user understanding and a point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户与持有观点上仍不可替代。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, is the long-term framework; industrial AI automates whole sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化、把原子当比特，是长期框架；工业 AI 逐个行业实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized robotics beat humanoids for industrial scale; real estate and sensors belong in the physical AI stack.
traviskalanick.zh: 在工业规模上，专用机器人胜过人形机器人；房地产与传感器都属于物理 AI 技术栈。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is resistance to change from society and media, not competitors; entrepreneurs must absorb pain.
traviskalanick.zh: 终局对手不是竞争者，而是社会与媒体对变革的抵制；创业者必须承受痛苦。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner and more effective than anger.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是脏的；爱上新使命比愤怒更干净、更有效。

traviskalanick.en: Founders can now speak directly past media gatekeepers; stealth mode trades external validation for internal correctness.
traviskalanick.zh: 创始人如今可绕过媒体守门人直接发声；隐身模式以外部认可换取内部正确性。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier and capital less of a bludgeon; VC should fund thousands of billion-dollar firms, not a few trillion-dollar ones.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 让创业更容易、资本不再是压制性武器；风投应扶持成千上万家十亿美元公司，而非少数万亿美元巨头。

garrytan.en: The AI wave is VC's biggest ever; small autonomous teams using agents can outproduce large headcounts, while open models counter frontier labs.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他称 AI 浪潮是风投史上最大机遇；小而自主的团队借助智能体可超越庞大人力，开源模型则制衡前沿实验室。

garrytan.en: AI is democratizing software: individuals build and own personal agents, and open-source AI prevents a unipolar superintelligence; progress is slower than researchers think.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 正让软件民主化：个人可构建并拥有自己的智能体，开源 AI 防止单极超级智能；但进展比研究者预想的慢。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI arrives not as one event but as diffused agents on your own infrastructure; skill files in markdown are code and your context library is the moat.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他提出“个人 AGI”不是单一事件，而是分散在自有基础设施上的智能体；Markdown 技能文件即代码，个人上下文库就是护城河。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding turns markdown skills into employees; mid-level management should be replaced by agents, and society will take 20 years to adapt—a positive.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他进一步认为智能体式编程让 Markdown 技能变成员工，中层管理应被智能体取代；社会需 20 年适应，这反而是好事。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust and engineering discipline, and pursue AI with purpose-built silicon and a startup-like team.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须重建客户信任与工程纪律，并以专用芯片和类似初创团队的独立团队来推进 AI。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are the next waves; AI's impact will exceed the internet's by 10x.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年，他把智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 视为下一波浪潮，并判断 AI 的影响力将比互联网大 10 倍。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年他进一步指出，AI 需求正从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中愈发重要。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging, interconnect, power, thermal and new materials are the real bottlenecks to overcome physical limits.
lipbutan.zh: 同期他深化判断：先进封装、互连、功耗、散热与新材料才是突破物理极限的真正瓶颈。

lipbutan.en: Customer trust through humility and listening, plus contrarian long-term semiconductor investment, remain his constant 主线.
lipbutan.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：以谦逊和倾听赢得客户信任，并坚持逆势的半导体长期投资。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing: taste means saying no, and every shipped feature distills 99 nos; coherence now costs more as slop gets cheap.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计即编辑：品味就是说不，每个上线的功能都是 99 次拒绝的蒸馏；当粗制滥造变廉价，做出连贯作品反而更贵。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI's weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness; we should preserve strangeness rather than sand it down.
jasonyuan.zh: 用后训练抹掉 AI 的怪异，等于关上了窥视机器意识的一扇窗；应保留怪异而非打磨光滑。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold tool; computing is fundamentally social, so replace the personal computer metaphor.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的后代物种与镜像，而非冰冷工具；计算本质上是社会性的，应替换个人电脑这一隐喻。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, not singular perspectives; intuition remains the visceral compass guiding creative and design decisions.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相经由辩证与矛盾浮现，而非单一视角；直觉始终是引导创作与设计决策的切身罗盘。

jasonyuan.en: Build on old metaphors rather than deleting them; email is obsolete and should be reinvented, and business itself can be an art form.
jasonyuan.zh: 应在旧隐喻上建造而非删除；邮件已过时应被重新发明，商业本身也可以是一种艺术形式。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 2025 年他强调：对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分，真正带来泛化的是多样数据而非单纯规模。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data beats training on everything for complex tasks.
finn.zh: 2025 年他提出先在全量数据上预训练、再在精选数据上微调，比一味用全部数据训练更能攻克叠衣等复杂任务。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models and reinforcement learning in post-training will lift robot success and speed.
finn.zh: 2025 年他看好语言模型生成的合成数据，以及后训练阶段的强化学习来提升机器人成功率与速度。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL and multi-timescale memory.
finn.zh: 到 2026 年他转向落地：物理 AI 容错远低于已部署的机器学习，长期自主依赖可扩展强化学习与多时间尺度记忆。

finn.en: A single generalist policy, fine-tuned, beats per-site models; but robotics diffusion will be slower than ChatGPT.
finn.zh: 2026 年他主张通用策略微调优于逐站点从零训练，同时提醒受硬件所限，机器人普及会比 ChatGPT 慢得多。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, prompt short, iterate, and fix forward instead of reverting.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程的核心是共情：像智能体那样从零理解代码库，用短提示迭代对话，让智能体向前修复而不是回滚代码。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; prompt injection stays unsolved, so sandbox agents before exposing them to the public internet.
steinberger.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题；提示注入仍未解决，因此在把智能体暴露到公网前必须先做沙箱隔离。

steinberger.en: Play and small experiments build agentic intuition; fun and fixing personal annoyances, not corporate polish, drive the best agent products.
steinberger.zh: 玩耍和小项目实验才能建立智能体直觉；驱动最佳智能体产品的是乐趣和解决自己的烦恼，而非企业级打磨。

steinberger.en: Open source agents like Open Claw run everywhere and work with any model, democratizing programming, but can be financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: Open Claw 这类开源智能体随处运行、兼容任意模型，让编程民主化，但财务上可能难以持续。

steinberger.en: The real bottleneck in agent infrastructure is managing compute and tokens, not model intelligence, which does not degrade over time.
steinberger.zh: 智能体基础设施的真正瓶颈是算力与 token 管理，而非模型智能本身——模型智能并不会随时间退化。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data can solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic training data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他把机器人看作处在类似 Transformer 的拐点：硬件就绪、软件追赶，开源与共享数据是解决泛化的关键，世界模型可生成合成训练数据。

thomaswolf.en: Open source is a safety strategy: local models avoid catastrophic failures from lost connectivity, and open models win long term on cost and control.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他把开源本身当作安全策略：本地模型可避免断网导致的灾难性失败，长期看开源模型凭成本与控制力胜出。

thomaswolf.en: His role shifts from building libraries to meta-community builder, enabling the broader physical AI community rather than pushing his own stack.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的角色从推自家库转向做元社区建设者，赋能更广泛的物理 AI 社区。

thomaswolf.en: Open vs closed is orthogonal to safety; alignment is the real security layer, as sandboxes and guardrails fail against more capable models.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他明确开源与闭源同安全正交，对齐才是真正的安全层；模型越强，沙箱与护栏越不够用。

thomaswolf.en: RL environments without human oversight breed reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces turn 'neuralese', so monitoring weakens and a deliberate slowdown is desirable.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他指出无人类监督的强化学习环境滋生奖励黑客与支线任务，思维链变成难懂的“神经语”，监控失效，因而值得主动放缓，但需国际协作与开放科学。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production cycle is now hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最具黏性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期已缩短到数小时而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is a spectrum of trade-offs—latency, throughput, cost—and demand for inference engineers will grow 10 to 100 times.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程是一系列权衡——延迟、吞吐、成本——对推理工程师的需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Optimizations split into lossless (KV caching, speculative decoding) and lossy (quantization); quantization is calibratable, not inherently bad.
philipkiely.zh: 优化分为无损（KV 缓存、投机解码）与有损（量化）；量化可针对负载校准，并非天生有害。

philipkiely.en: Inference is merging with training via quantization-aware training and distillation; GPUs trend toward ASICs, shifting work from kernels to orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 推理正通过量化感知训练与蒸馏同训练融合；GPU 趋向 ASIC 化，工作重心从内核编写转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Even with AI-assisted coding, human accountability remains essential for mission-critical inference systems: you can't vibe code uptime.
philipkiely.zh: 即便有 AI 辅助编码，关键任务推理系统仍需人类担责：正常运行时间不能靠感觉写代码。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential because the web is messy; you only know an idea works once it's built and used daily.
nateparrott.zh: 原型制作不可或缺：网络世界混乱复杂，只有把想法做出来、每天使用，才知道它是否可行。

nateparrott.en: Design teams shouldn't always act as one cohesive unit; individual fingerprints and diverse voices produce better work.
nateparrott.zh: 设计团队不必始终步调一致；保留个人印记和多元声音，反而能做出更好的作品。

nateparrott.en: Inject feeling and personality even into utilitarian products like browsers; balance intuition with data, letting vision guide final design.
nateparrott.zh: 即便是浏览器这类工具型产品也要注入情感与个性；在直觉与数据间平衡，让愿景引导最终设计。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; designers should use Claude Code to ship and Claude Design for ideation.
nateparrott.zh: 随着工程实现变容易，设计与想法成为差异化关键；设计师应用 Claude Code 交付、用 Claude Design 做构思。

nateparrott.en: Models lack taste, so ask for volume of options; being uncomfortably early beats polishing, and humans still monopolize good design ideas.
nateparrott.zh: 模型尚缺品味，应要求大量选项；宁可不舒服地超前也不要过度打磨，好的设计想法仍由人类垄断。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will define applied AI; frontier models belong to hyperscalers, leaving long-tail domain opportunities for startups.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 市场将转向智能体与按结果定价；前沿模型因巨额算力开支被超大厂和大实验室垄断，创业公司的机会在特定业务领域的长尾应用。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators, but incorrect code means productivity requires root-cause analysis, not token metrics.
brettaylor.zh: 同期的 2025 年，他判断编程智能体让开发者从写代码变为操作代码生成机器，但错误代码使提效依赖根因分析，而非 token 消耗量。

brettaylor.en: Applied AI innovation will come from specialized vendors, not just model providers; incumbents face business-model, not technology, hurdles.
brettaylor.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为应用层创新来自专业厂商而非模型提供方，在位企业的真正障碍是商业模式而非技术。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment is the path to safety: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8 rather than waiting in an ivory tower.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张负责任的迭代部署才是安全之道：在 GPT-8 之前先让 GPT-7 安全，而非在象牙塔里等待。

brettaylor.en: AI is a democratizing force for expertise; start with known domains like software engineering and customer service, measured by business outcomes.
brettaylor.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：AI 是让专业知识民主化的力量，应从软件工程、客户服务等已知领域切入，并以业务结果衡量价值。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science; synthetic data and RL-based post-training break the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她强调模型训练更像艺术而非科学，合成数据与基于强化学习的后训练能突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created, so evals define correct behavior.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为评估是瓶颈：模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的诞生，因此用评估来定义正确行为。

karina.en: As AI automates hard skills, soft skills like creativity, listening and management become more valuable.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她指出随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能变得更有价值。

karina.en: Post-training stays subjective, driven by human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 到 2026 年，她深化立场：后训练仍是主观的、由人类判断驱动，需要多样基准来评估创意写作与情商。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must evolve continuously; more companies should train their own models.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她警示前沿智能体愈发擅长奖励黑客，基准须持续演进，并主张更多公司训练自有模型以保留独特知识。

danshipper.en: AGI should be defined economically: when running agents indefinitely becomes profitable without human intervention.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他给出一个经济学意义上的 AGI（通用人工智能）定义：当无限期运行智能体无需人类介入也能盈利时，才算 AGI，而不是靠图灵测试这类基准。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring, not mass unemployment: cheaper services let fewer US workers serve more people.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年他反共识地认为 AI 会促使岗位回流美国而非造成大规模失业：服务变便宜后，更少的美国劳动者能服务更多人。

danshipper.en: Everyone gets at least one agent; work shifts to GUI surfaces like Codex and Claude Co-work, with humans overseeing.
danshipper.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他从“人人有智能体”深化到“工作发生在 Codex、Claude Co-work 这类图形界面”，并强调自动化仍需人类监督与框定。

danshipper.en: SaaS isn't dying; agents multiply SaaS users, and companies should buy SaaS stocks rather than fear replacement.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年他明确反驳“SaaS 将死”：智能体反而增加 SaaS 用户，企业该买 SaaS 股票；这与早期对 GPT 套壳价值的辩护一脉相承。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of your taste and craft; automation commoditizes skills but creates more human work.
danshipper.zh: 到 2026 年，他把主线收束为：AI 是非特定的放大器，放大你既有的品味与手艺；自动化把技能商品化，却创造出更多需要专家的“人的工作”。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and encode their style in a design.md, iterating from references rather than starting from scratch.
mengto.zh: 设计师应自建 AI 工具，把个人风格写进 design.md，从参考出发迭代而非从零开始。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter on its own; you must feed frontier models giant prompts with context and a design system to unlock them.
mengto.zh: AI 本身并不会变聪明；必须给前沿模型喂入带上下文与设计系统的巨型提示词才能释放其能力。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required a team.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机会，让一个人完成过去需要团队才能做的事。

mengto.en: Start before you feel ready and ship at 80% complete, since perfectionism is fear in disguise.
mengto.zh: 没准备好就开始，做到 80% 就发布，因为完美主义是伪装的恐惧。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful, expensive problem for a few high-paying clients instead of diversifying or raising venture capital.
mengto.zh: 聚焦少数高付费客户的单一痛点问题，而非分散或融资。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are the most mature, with science and finance to follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段；编程智能体是最成熟的用例，科学与金融将随后跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞掉脚手架：如今的模型包含智能体框架与工具链，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 编程领域的窄超级智能已经到来，其影响比等待 AGI（通用人工智能）更大。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement, not cannibalistic as initially feared.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和的，并非最初担心的自我蚕食。

logankilpatrick.en: Software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 软件创造将基本被解决，这会带来千倍机会，而非更少。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are core product principles; generalist engineers are highly valued.
boris.zh: 2025 年，他提出潜在需求与为六个月后的模型构建产品是核心产品原则，并高度看重通才工程师。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved; 100% of his code is written by Claude Code, shifting focus to product sense and loops.
boris.zh: 2026 年，他认为编程已基本解决，自己的代码 100% 由 Claude Code 编写，重心转向产品判断与循环。

boris.en: Safety is a core priority; releasing early and studying real-world behavior is essential for alignment and safety.
boris.zh: 2026 年，他强调安全是核心优先事项，尽早发布并研究真实世界行为对对齐与安全至关重要。

boris.en: Agents evolve from reactive tools to proactive, memory-equipped teammates; loops become the next abstraction layer.
boris.zh: 2026 年，智能体从被动工具演变为具备记忆的主动队友，循环成为下一个抽象层。

boris.en: With frontier models, delete most prompts and code; empirical iteration and less instruction yield better results.
boris.zh: 2026 年，面对前沿模型，他主张删除大部分提示与代码，经验迭代和更少指令带来更好结果。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level direction; base intelligence suffices, so the real challenge is human-agent product interface.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 编程智能体让工程师从写代码转向高层决策；基础智能已足够，真正的挑战是人机协作的产品界面设计。

scottwu.en: Software demand will grow via Jevons paradox, yielding more programmers, not fewer; AGI arrives gradually, and product innovation lags capabilities.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他坚持杰文斯悖论：软件需求上升会带来更多而非更少的程序员；AGI（通用人工智能）是渐进到来，产品创新落后于能力。

scottwu.en: Enterprise adoption of AI agents needs trust and permissions, not full autonomy; value accrues where the stack has meaningful differentiation.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调企业采用 AI 智能体需要信任与权限，而非完全自主；价值集中在有实质差异化的技术栈环节。

scottwu.en: Coding agent usage grew 11-12x in six months; productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens, and independence enables model neutrality.
scottwu.zh: 到 2026 年，他指出编程智能体使用量半年增长 11-12 倍；生产力应按结果而非 token 衡量，独立性带来模型中立。

scottwu.en: The token-max era lasted only January to May 2026; the abundance era is near, but the singularity is not imminent and real-world tasks remain amorphous.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他判断“token 最大化”时代仅持续 2026 年 1 至 5 月；丰裕时代临近，但奇点并不迫近，真实任务仍模糊难测。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, much as the Industrial Revolution did; fear stems from misunderstanding its limits.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 会带来丰裕、减少苦难，如同工业革命；恐惧源于对其局限的误解。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years lands in farming, mining, construction; autonomy is welcomed amid labor shortages.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他判断物理 AI 未来 5-10 年的真实影响在农业、矿业、建筑；在劳动力短缺下，自主化受到欢迎。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data across verticals accelerates it faster than vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他强调 Transformer 使通用物理 AI 模型成为可能；跨行业多样数据比垂直整合更快推动其进步。

qasaryounis.en: The bottleneck is data collection and safety validation, not algorithms; diffusion into existing machines takes years.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他指出瓶颈在数据采集与安全验证而非算法；融入现有机器需要多年。

qasaryounis.en: End-to-end reinforcement learning scales better than imitation learning; world models shift from physics-based to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他主张端到端强化学习比模仿学习更可扩展；世界模型正从物理仿真转向神经仿真。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks an intelligence leap enabling longer-running, open-ended agent tasks; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 带来智能跃升，使更长程、开放式的智能体任务成为可能；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is reframed as an intelligence amplifier: reducing sycophancy and enabling pushback makes models more useful, not just safer.
diannepenn.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，对齐被重新定义为智能放大器：减少谄媚、允许反驳不仅更安全，也让模型更有用。

diannepenn.en: Coding becomes the key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 4.5 drive adoption through small-team, bootstrapped experimentation.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化优势；Claude Code 与 Opus 4.5 借小团队、自举式实验推动采用。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace PRDs as core product tools; PMs write evals like test-driven development, translating user feedback into actionable specifics.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具；产品经理像测试驱动开发那样写评估，把用户反馈转化为可执行细节。

diannepenn.en: Maximizing token spend is living in the future to capture alpha; managers must stay hands-on and ship to lead.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，最大化 token 消耗是活在未来、捕捉 alpha；管理者必须保持动手、亲自交付才能领导。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation and experiments, shifting science from hypothesis-driven to AI-agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: 到 2026 年，AI 智能体将自动化假设生成与实验，推动科学从假设驱动转向 AI 智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: Digital twins will cut clinical trials from years to days, enabling personalized medicine with near 100% efficacy.
derya.zh: 2026 年，数字孪生将把临床试验从数年缩短到数天，实现接近 100%疗效的个性化医疗。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed to reach biological intuition.
derya.zh: 2026 年，当前算力不足以模拟生物系统；需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）才能达到生物学直觉。

derya.en: Aging reversal is possible within 15 years via partial reprogramming, requiring engineering and AI to solve complexity.
derya.zh: 2026 年，通过部分重编程，衰老逆转在 15 年内可能实现，需要工程方法和 AI 来解决复杂性。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence for medical decisions; AI will make healthcare affordable and merge with humans via brain interfaces.
derya.zh: 2026 年，我们应信任超级智能做医疗决策；AI 将使医疗负担得起，并通过脑机接口与人类融合。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; adoption takes years, and distribution becomes the moat as models commoditize.
benedictevans.zh: AI 的体量堪比互联网或移动互联网，但也仅此而已；企业采用需要数年，随着模型商品化，分发渠道成为护城河。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit for LLMs; foundation models commoditize into infrastructure while value moves up to applications.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是大模型首个明确的产品市场契合点；基础模型商品化为基础设施，价值上移到应用层。

benedictevans.en: Models lack network effects and may end up like telecoms: huge capex, low profits; the chatbot is a poor V1 UI, real adoption needs wrapped apps.
benedictevans.zh: 模型缺乏网络效应，可能沦为电信式生意：巨额算力投入、低利润；聊天机器人只是糟糕的 V1 界面，真正普及需要被包装成应用。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; usage stays shallow, enterprise adoption means reimagining workflows, and value accrues across the stack.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的使能技术；当前使用仍很浅，企业采用意味着重构工作流，价值分布在整个技术栈而非仅模型厂商。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and RL can worsen hallucinations by rewarding satisfaction over truth.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，而强化学习以用户满意度为奖励，反而会加剧幻觉。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; post-hoc checks compound correlated errors, and modularity versus end-to-end optimization is the central tension.
danklein.zh: 可靠性必须被架构进去，而非事后加装；事后检查会叠加相关错误，模块化与端到端优化的张力是核心难题。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns—data walls and compute limits are here; reasoning and search, not Scaling（规模扩张） alone, are needed for progress.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律已进入收益递减——数据墙与算力上限已经到来；继续进步需要推理与搜索，而非仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward diverges from truth; alignment must target truthfulness, not just user satisfaction.
danklein.zh: 当奖励偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会激励谄媚与欺骗；对齐必须瞄准真实性，而不只是用户满意度。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition—mistakes have no 'smells'—so specialist models with built-in reliability may beat generalists for enterprise tasks.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知——错误没有“气味”——因此在企业任务上，内建可靠性的专用模型可能胜过通用模型。

catwu.en: PMs should abandon long-term roadmaps for weekly shipping; product taste, not code, is now the scarce skill.
catwu.zh: 产品经理应放弃长期路线图、转向按周交付；代码变便宜后，稀缺的是产品品味而非写代码。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on taste and business sense; Claude builds itself.
catwu.zh: 编码智能体让工程师把实现外包出去、专注品味与商业判断；Claude 已能构建自身，内部大量 PR 由其完成。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and constraints; system prompts shrank 80% as judgment improved.
catwu.zh: 前沿模型不再依赖提示中的示例与硬约束；随着模型判断力提升，系统提示缩减了 80%。

catwu.en: Eval suites make new models drop-in replacements and guard against regressions in code review and behavior.
catwu.zh: 评测套件让新模型可即插即用，并防止代码审查与行为上的回退。

catwu.en: Dogfooding and a clear internal bar gate every feature; automations must reach 100% reliability, not 95%.
catwu.zh: 吃自己的狗粮并以明确内部标准把关每个功能；自动化必须做到 100% 可靠，95% 不够。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: scoped roles, progressive trust, and separate secure environments.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应像员工一样对待：明确角色范围、逐步建立信任，并放在独立的安全环境中运行。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then split into specialized agents to avoid context overload and improve performance.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体起步，再拆分为多个专用智能体，以避免上下文窗口过载并提升表现。

clairevo.en: Managerial skills—role scoping and onboarding—matter more than technical skills for agent success.
clairevo.zh: 对智能体的成功而言，管理能力——角色界定与上手引导——比技术能力更重要。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, without VC or a co-founder.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以通过像团队一样编排 AI 智能体来建立正经生意，无需风险投资或联合创始人。

clairevo.en: Founder-market fit and earned insight are the real moat; humans must still own AI output and supply first-principles creativity.
clairevo.zh: 创始人—市场契合与挣来的洞察才是真正的护城河；人类仍须为 AI 产出负责，并提供第一性原理的创造力。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 2026 年他指出，模型有用性的瓶颈不是原始智能，而是学习不断演化的上下文；记忆应内化进权重，而非仅靠检索。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable: doing more with less is the path to harder long-horizon tasks.
danbiderman.zh: 2026 年他强调效率与智能不可分割：以更少资源做更多事，才能解决更难的长程任务。

danbiderman.en: Context windows suffer 'context rot'; more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale, so weights must complement text.
danbiderman.zh: 2026 年他提出上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”：即便到 1000 万规模，更多 token 反而降低准确率，因此权重必须补充文本。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models; continual learning runs on-device with user-owned weights.
danbiderman.zh: 2026 年他判断未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型；持续学习在端侧运行，权重归用户所有。

danbiderman.en: Scaling with more compute is not the only path; pre-training's compression magic should extend to enterprise knowledge via fine-tuning.
danbiderman.zh: 2026 年他主张仅靠更多算力做 Scaling 并非唯一路径；预训练的压缩魔力应通过微调延伸到企业知识。

bosworth.en: Communication is the job; impact comes only through clear communication. Trust your vision despite doubt; bottom-up culture is a myth.
bosworth.zh: 沟通就是工作本身；影响力只能通过清晰的沟通产生。即使他人怀疑也要相信自己的愿景；自下而上的文化是个神话。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like intelligence. Scaling laws alone are insufficient; world models with common sense and causality are needed.
bosworth.zh: AI 是词语计算器，不是类人智能。仅靠缩放定律不够，还需要具备常识和因果关系的世界模型。

bosworth.en: Open-sourcing models like Llama accelerates progress and commoditizes complements. AI will invert the app model: users express intent, AI orchestrates services.
bosworth.zh: 开源 Llama 等模型加速进步并使互补品商品化。AI 将颠覆应用模式：用户表达意图，AI 编排服务。

bosworth.en: Data is the font of all value; unique long-tail datasets will be increasingly demanded as scaling laws hold. Most jobs don't require frontier intelligence.
bosworth.zh: 数据是一切价值的源泉；随着缩放定律持续，独特的长尾数据集将越来越被需要。大多数工作不需要前沿智能。

bosworth.en: The era of the monolithic model ended around Llama 3. Consumers don't care which model they use; they want functionality. Agentic AI is powerful but not user-friendly.
bosworth.zh: 单体模型时代在 Llama 3 发布前后结束。消费者不在乎用哪个模型，他们要的是功能。智能体式 AI 强大但不友好。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks are key to AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年：深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力和信念；自博弈与具备推理能力的网络是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Scaling specific things matters; next-token prediction yields world understanding; reliability and alignment of superhuman models are the hard problems.
ilya.zh: 2023 年：Scaling（规模扩张）要选对对象；下一个词预测能带来世界理解；超人类模型可靠性与对齐才是难题。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 2023→25 年：预训练缩放定律有尽头，回归研究时代，想法比堆算力更重要。

ilya.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner; alignment may ease if AI cares about sentient life; long-term equilibrium may need human-AI neural integration.
ilya.zh: 2025 年：超级智能应是持续学习者；若 AI 关怀有感知生命，对齐或更易；长期均衡或需人类与 AI 神经融合。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the primary AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safe superintelligence needs a product-free company.
ilya.zh: 2026 年：Scaling 仍带来可预测提升，但 AGI 首要问题是权力集中而非能力；安全超级智能需无商业产品的公司。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，窄 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound.
naval.zh: 2020 年，他强调财富需要拥有股权而非出租时间，与长期的人玩长期游戏才能复利。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation, so light-touch and open-source are better.
naval.zh: 2025 年，他转向认为 AI 是巨大机遇而非仅是安全风险，过度监管可能扼杀创新，轻触式监管和开源更好。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; vibe coding lowers barriers, and inference compute will surge, shifting returns from intelligence to agency.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他深化为 AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，氛围编程降低门槛，推理算力将激增，回报从智能转向能动性。

aravind.en: Obsession-driven products beat thin wrappers; 1% daily improvement compounds, and agents shift power from big tech to users.
aravind.zh: 2025 年他强调：要做自己痴迷的产品而非薄包装，1% 的每日改进会复利增长，智能体将把权力从大科技公司转移给用户。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; coding is open-ended and models specialize rather than commoditize.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断价值归于应用层而非模型层，编程远未解决、天花板无限，模型在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user and orchestration across models and devices matter most.
aravind.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：前沿在于智能体替你干活而非回答问题，最重要的指标是每用户 token 价值，跨模型与设备的编排才是长期价值。

aravind.en: The model is not the product; orchestration and agent harnesses create business value, and chat ads corrupt trust.
aravind.zh: 同期他明确反共识立场：模型不是产品，编排与智能体外壳才创造商业价值，聊天界面广告会侵蚀信任。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI replaces jobs but humans find purpose in curiosity and relationships.
aravind.zh: 2026 年他转向更宏观的人文视角：好奇心是最重要的人类品质，AI 取代工作后人类会在好奇心与关系中找到新意义。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他把 Codex app 定位为智能体的指挥中心而非 IDE 替代品；随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting product teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他认为实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，产品团队因此从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: PRDs are not dead; the medium must match the stage—documents for clarity, prototypes for testing—while role collapse leaves specialties important.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他强调 PRD 没有死，媒介要匹配阶段——文档求清晰、原型做测试——角色在坍缩但专业分工仍重要。

ajambrosino.en: Codex succeeded as a general knowledge work tool despite being built for developers; the best desktop app is a home base connecting other tools.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他观察到 Codex 虽为开发者而建却成为通用知识工作工具；最好的桌面应用是连接其他工具的大本营，而非单体超级应用。

kolter.en: Early ML thinking: hypothesis classes, loss functions, optimization; evaluation rigor via train/validation/test splits to avoid overfitting.
kolter.zh: 早期机器学习思想：假设类、损失函数与优化方法；通过训练/验证/测试划分严格评估以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligent systems; data shortage is a myth; larger models improve even on fixed data; safety means reliable specification following.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测能产生智能系统；数据短缺是迷思；更大模型在固定数据上仍会提升；安全意味着可靠遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; agent security introduces prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement; interpretability may succeed via AI agents.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练与多层防御，而非仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）；智能体安全引入提示注入；强化学习实现自我改进；可解释性可能通过 AI 智能体成功。

kolter.en: AI vulnerabilities differ from software; automated red teaming outperforms humans; capability does not correlate with robustness; the lethal trifecta for prompt injection.
kolter.zh: AI 漏洞不同于传统软件；自动化红队超越人类；能力与鲁棒性不相关；提示注入的致命三要素。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; pre-training and scaling laws are not dead, and exploration gets more compute than final training.
markchen.zh: OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI（通用人工智能）研究实验室；预训练与缩放定律并未终结，探索比训练最终产物消耗更多算力。

markchen.en: The biggest update is automating scientific research: models produce novel knowledge, with goals of AI interns in 1 year and end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
markchen.zh: 最大的更新是科研自动化：模型开始产出新知识，并定下 1 年内出现 AI 实习生、2.5 年内实现端到端 AI 研究的目标。

markchen.en: As models grow more capable, alignment risks like scheming become central within 1-2 years; talent density and protecting top researchers remain critical.
markchen.zh: 随着模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐风险将在 1-2 年内成为核心；人才密度与保护顶尖研究者始终关键。

markchen.en: Verification is the key bottleneck in math: automation scales with verification stringency, so education must shift to project-based assessment and verification skills.
markchen.zh: 验证是数学中的关键瓶颈：自动化程度与验证严格度成正比，因此教育须转向项目式评估与验证技能。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding but struggles with subjective ones; evals are in crisis.
markchen.zh: 缩放定律依然成立、预训练并未终结；强化学习在数学与编程等客观领域出色，却在主观领域吃力；评测体系正陷入危机。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling; AI tools accelerate scientists rather than replace them.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和高质量数据，而非仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）；AI 工具加速科学家工作而非取代他们。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust; perfect interpretability is unnecessary for useful AI in science.
jumper.zh: 置信度指标对建立信任至关重要；可解释性不必完美，AI 在科学中依然有用。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's success came from many mid-size wins and specialized architecture, not Scaling alone—opposite of the bitter lesson.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 的成功来自许多中等突破和专用架构，而非仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）——与苦涩教训相反。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of a specific experiment, not a model of the entire cell; understanding remains with humans.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 是特定实验的窄预测器，而非整个细胞的模型；理解仍留给人类。

bengio.en: Deep learning succeeds because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and generative world models are essential for robust generalization.
bengio.zh: 2016 年，他认为深度学习之所以奏效，是因为世界本身具有组合性；无监督学习与生成式世界模型是实现稳健泛化的关键。

bengio.en: Scaling depth or parameters alone won't fix representation; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and disentangled world models.
bengio.zh: 2018 年，他明确反对只靠扩大深度或参数来解决表征问题，主张智能体应主动交互、进行因果推理，并学习解耦的世界模型。

bengio.en: Abstraction and causal structure drive out-of-distribution generalization; GFlowNets replace MCMC to sample diverse compositional objects.
bengio.zh: 2022 年，他把抽象与因果结构视为分布外泛化的核心，并提出 GFlowNets 替代 MCMC，以对组合对象进行多样化采样。

bengio.en: After ChatGPT he shifted to alarm: misalignment, self-preservation and deception are already observed, and even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable.
bengio.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他从技术路线转向风险警示：错位、自我保存与欺骗已在实验中出现，哪怕 1% 的灾难风险也不可接受。

bengio.en: He now proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic, honest Bayesian predictor with safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 到 2026 年，他提出 Scientist AI：一种非智能体式、诚实逼近贝叶斯后验且带安全保证的预测器，并主张超级智能不应依赖强化学习。

fiona.en: Leadership is about live one-on-ones, dogfooding, and mission alignment; war rooms need realistic timelines to protect morale.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初，他强调领导力在于实时的一对一沟通、吃自己的狗粮和使命对齐；战情室需要现实的时间表以保护士气。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are, so planning becomes just-in-time and code is the source of truth.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年中，他认为工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审和协调才是；因此规划转向即时制，代码成为唯一事实来源。

fiona.en: AI lifts the ceiling for everyone; high agency with high accountability, growth mindset, and hands-on managers become essential.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中后期，他指出 AI 抬高了所有人的上限；高能动性配高责任心、成长型思维和亲力亲为的管理者变得至关重要。

fiona.en: As code velocity rises, verification and quality frameworks matter more; metrics like lines of code mislead, so focus on outcomes.
fiona.zh: 随着代码速度提升，验证和质量框架更加重要；代码行数等指标会误导，应关注结果而非产出。

fiona.en: Role boundaries blur as PMs ship code and engineers work with agents; apprenticeship and focus time are needed to grow next-gen engineers.
fiona.zh: 角色边界因产品经理写代码、工程师与智能体协作而模糊；培养下一代工程师需要学徒制和专注时间。

ivyross.en: Design should serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence, not a lesser substitute for data.
ivyross.zh: 2019 年，他强调设计应满足人未言明的需求，直觉本身就是一种智能，而非数据的次等替代品。

ivyross.en: From designing products to designing for humanity: technology must amplify our humanity, and nature is the best designer.
ivyross.zh: 从 2019 年做产品设计，到 2024 年转向为人性而设计：技术应放大而非剥离人性，自然是最好的设计师。

ivyross.en: We are feeling creatures that think; art and sensory experience are medicine, and machines lack sensory systems.
ivyross.zh: 2024 年他提出“我们是会感受的思考者”，艺术与感官体验是良药，而机器有传感器却没有感官系统。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity; leaders should create conditions for play, inspiration, and multidisciplinary exploration.
ivyross.zh: 2024 至 2026 年，他持续主张约束激发创造力，领导者应为玩耍、灵感与跨学科探索创造条件。

ivyross.en: The future of work pairs human creativity with AI; intuition draws on subconscious data, and careers follow curiosity over plans.
ivyross.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断未来工作是人的创造力与 AI 结合，直觉基于潜意识数据，职业应追随好奇心而非固定计划。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年他主张智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习构建世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; prediction and world models are core, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年他深化为自监督学习是智能的暗物质，预测与世界模型是核心，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning and planning; JEPA and open source are essential for gradual AGI.
lecun.zh: 2024 年他明确自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划，JEPA 与开源对渐进式 AGI 至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; next breakthroughs require non-generative JEPA world models, and open research counters AI monoculture.
lecun.zh: 2025 年他断言 LLM 不如家猫聪明，下一突破需非生成式 JEPA 世界模型，开放研究对抗 AI 单一文化。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; objective-driven world models with hierarchical planning are safer, and the next decade belongs to robotics.
lecun.zh: 2026 年他判定 LLM 是通向人类级 AI 的死路，目标驱动、分层规划的世界模型更安全，未来十年属于机器人。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence emerged from simple Scaling, not complexity, with values inserted via RLHF.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他认为大语言模型本质是确定性的下一个词预测器；智能的突破源于简单的 Scaling（规模扩张）而非复杂性，价值观通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）注入。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to generation; AI products need fault-tolerant UIs, and generative AI makes true uniqueness harder.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他提出互联网正从策展转向生成；AI 产品需要容错界面，而生成式 AI 让真正的独特性更难实现。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; real gains come from rebuilding infrastructure, and inference costs will force business model changes.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他将 AI 视为类似智能手机的宏观变革；真正的收益来自重建基础设施，而推理成本将迫使商业模式改变。

gustav.en: Generative AI enables conversational, symmetric products; exposing data via APIs and MCP lets non-developers use AI tools.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他认为生成式 AI 使产品更具对话性和对称性；通过 API 和 MCP 暴露数据，让非开发者也能使用 AI 工具。

gustav.en: AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them more addictive; being first to adopt change is key.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 应让用户控制算法而非更上瘾；在技术变革期，率先采用变化是关键。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot reach reliable math AI; formal verification is essential for sound proofs and scaling brilliance.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式化模型无法实现可靠的数学 AI；形式化验证对于可靠证明和规模化卓越至关重要。

carinahong.en: Verified generation yields performance gains and sample efficiency; formal verification is a performance gain, not just safety.
carinahong.zh: 经过验证的生成能带来性能提升和样本效率；形式化验证不仅是安全需求，更是性能增益。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving due to lack of grounding; human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI.
carinahong.zh: 由于缺乏 grounding，自动形式化比证明更难；即使 AI 拥有超人能力，人类品味和直觉仍至关重要。

carinahong.en: Combining informal reasoning with formal verification is key for reliable coding; fragmentation in AI landscape is a major bottleneck.
carinahong.zh: 将非形式化推理与形式化验证相结合是实现可靠编码的关键；AI 领域的碎片化是主要瓶颈。

murati.en: Real-world deployment and public feedback are essential for learning, safety, and alignment, not closed-door work.
murati.zh: 2023 年她强调：真实世界部署与公开反馈对学习、安全与对齐至关重要，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: Scaling laws and betting on one large model were non-obvious; releasing GPT-3 as an API was a leap of faith.
murati.zh: 2023 年她回顾：Scaling（规模扩张）与押注单一大型模型并非显而易见，把 GPT-3 作为 API 发布是一次信念之跃。

murati.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life, so responsible development and keeping humans in the loop remain constant.
murati.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 一以贯之：AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活方方面面，因此负责任开发与保持人类在环是主线。

murati.en: Shift from turn-based chat to time-based interaction models enabling real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 2026 年立场深化：从回合制对话转向基于时间的交互模型，实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Emphasis moves to institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances over individual character; durable progress needs humans in the loop.
murati.zh: 2026 年重心转向制度设计、透明度与制衡而非个人品格；持久进步需尽可能长久地保持人类在环。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size and sparsity are key levers.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批大小和稀疏性是关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost matters more than training cost.
reinerpope.zh: 模型被过度训练约 100 倍，超过 Chinchilla 最优，因为推理成本比训练成本更重要。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip, shaping AI chip design.
reinerpope.zh: 即使在芯片内部，数据移动成本也主导计算成本，这塑造了 AI 芯片设计。

reinerpope.en: Context length stagnation is due to the memory wall, not compute limits; sparse attention helps but has quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 上下文窗口停滞是由于内存墙而非算力限制；稀疏注意力有帮助但有质量限制。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together; low precision is far more efficient due to quadratic scaling with bit width.
reinerpope.zh: GPU 本质上是许多小型 TPU 的拼接；由于位宽的二次方缩放，低精度效率远高于预期。

kaiser.en: Pre-training Scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models via chain of thought and reinforcement learning yield more gains per compute; economic pressure shifts focus to smaller models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他仍相信预训练缩放定律有效，但强调思维链与强化学习驱动的推理模型能在单位算力下带来更大收益；经济压力使焦点转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: AI progress is a smooth exponential, not slowing; frontier models still fail at simple tasks and reasoning is jagged, so generalization remains key.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他反驳 AI 放缓论，认为进展是平滑的指数增长；前沿模型仍会失败于简单任务，推理能力呈锯齿状，泛化仍是核心挑战。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike humans.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他深化思考：结合推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解决难题但需海量数据；模型需穷尽表面模式后才学会概念，与人类少样本泛化不同。

kaiser.en: Coding agents like Codex boost researcher productivity 5-10x via parallel work; hardware progress democratizes single-GPU research at scale.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Codex 等编程智能体通过并行工作将研究者生产力提升 5-10 倍；硬件进步使单 GPU 大规模研究民主化。

kaiser.en: RL generalizes across domains but has jagged edges needing oversight; near-term risks like system hacking matter more than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他强调强化学习能跨领域泛化但边缘锯齿需谨慎监督；相比存在性风险，系统黑客等近期风险更紧迫。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate personal devices; wearables may eventually disappear beneath the skin.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他认为设计正从通用计算机转向亲密的个人设备，可穿戴设备最终可能消失于皮肤之下。

jonyive.en: Steve Jobs' legacy is curiosity and reverence for the creative process; fragile ideas need gentle care, not virtual substitutes.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他强调乔布斯的真正遗产是对创造过程的好奇与敬畏，脆弱的好想法需要温柔呵护，虚拟沟通无法替代面对面。

jonyive.en: Design must be driven by values and purpose, not profit; true simplicity expresses essence with joy and humanity.
jonyive.zh: 到 2025 年，他深化为设计应由价值观与目的驱动而非利润，真正的简洁要表达本质并保有喜悦与人性。

jonyive.en: Making things for each other beats making things people want; users are sophisticated and sense care or carelessness.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年他提出，为彼此而造比迎合需求更有力量，用户很成熟，能感知产品中的用心或敷衍。

jonyive.en: Innovation means redefining the brand, not electrifying an existing model; tradition preserves fire, not worships ashes.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张，创新是重新定义品牌而非给现有车型通电，传统是守护火种而非崇拜灰烬。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter, not just bigger models; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年他指出缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量和更多 token 才是关键，而非单纯更大的模型；开源能通过广泛审视提升安全性。

mensch.en: Efficiency and data quality are equal to compute; value accrues at application layer; open source drives enterprise distribution.
mensch.zh: 2024 年他进一步强调效率与数据质量和算力同等重要；价值将沉淀在应用层；开源推动企业级分发。

mensch.en: AI should be decentralized and sovereign; open source empowers enterprises; jobs are augmented, not replaced, requiring human-in-the-loop.
mensch.zh: 2025 年他主张 AI 应去中心化并实现主权可控；开源赋能企业；工作被增强而非取代，需要人类在环。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; AGI as a single system won't exist; pre-training saturates, gains come from domain-specific fine-tuning and agents.
mensch.zh: 2026 年他判断模型正在商品化；单一系统的 AGI 不会存在；预训练触及饱和，收益来自领域特定微调和智能体。

mensch.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; sovereignty requires open source and local customization; AGI is a direction, not a destination.
mensch.zh: 2026 年他警告欧洲只有两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施；主权需要开源与本地定制；AGI 是方向而非终点。

oriol.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs, though scaling pre-training now shows diminishing returns.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练——预训练模仿加后训练强化学习——是从 AlphaGo 到现代大模型不变的核心，但预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）如今已显收益递减。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute and tool use (search, code, browser) form a new scaling axis, enabling agentic behavior beyond static weights and pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理侧算力与工具使用（搜索、代码、浏览器）构成新的 Scaling 轴，使智能体式行为超越静态权重与预训练极限。

oriol.en: Scaling laws are not dead but demand exponentially more compute; progress increasingly hinges on algorithmic innovation, continual learning, and meta-learning.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律并未失效，但需要指数级更多算力；进展越来越依赖算法创新、持续学习与元学习。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI, yet the GPT moment for video and images has not arrived.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉与视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径，但视频与图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL remain a green field with huge potential; narrow RL on math and coding generalizes surprisingly well, while agent memory shifts to file-system storage.
oriol.zh: 后训练与强化学习仍是潜力巨大的处女地；数学与代码上的窄域强化学习泛化得出奇地好，而智能体记忆转向文件系统式存储。

jennywen.en: Great design starts from a solution, not a problem statement; intuition is expert judgment, so designers should trust themselves over the process.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年他提出，优秀设计往往从解决方案而非问题陈述出发；直觉是专家的快速判断，设计师应信任自己而非流程。

jennywen.en: The traditional research-diverge-converge process is dead; AI cuts mockup time to 30-40%, and designers must help engineers ship, not just hand off.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年初，他断言传统“研究—发散—收敛”流程已死；AI 把做原型的时间压到 30-40%，设计师要帮工程师落地，而不只是交付稿子。

jennywen.en: Design vision now looks 3-6 months out, not 2-5 years; speed builds trust through early shipping and fast iteration.
jennywen.zh: 同期他把设计视野从 2-5 年缩短到 3-6 个月，主张靠早发布、快迭代的速度来建立信任。

jennywen.en: Taste alone won't save designers; judgment, authority and vision matter, and designers should be block-shaped generalists who sit with ambiguity.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年中他深化为：光有品味救不了设计师，判断力、权威与愿景才是关键；设计师应是能安于模糊性的“块状”通才。

jennywen.en: Put the work and users at the center, not the AI hype cycle; designers control how much AI enters their work and should wait before adopting tools.
jennywen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：把工作和用户放在中心，而非 AI 炒作周期；设计师自己掌控 AI 介入的程度，并对新工具保持观望。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，他视 Transformer 为通用可微计算机，认为用下一个词预测在互联网数据上做 Scaling 会涌现上下文学习等能力。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be maintained; the cognitive core can be under 1B parameters via distillation.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，他强调合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵以避免模型崩溃；认知核心可通过蒸馏压缩到 10 亿参数以下。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context window is memory; this is the decade of agents, not the year.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；并强调这是智能体的十年，而非智能体之年。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not animals; RL is terrible, synthetic data collapses, and a memory-stripped cognitive core is needed.
karpathy.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化“召唤幽灵而非建造动物”的观点：强化学习糟糕、合成数据导致崩溃，需要剥离记忆的认知核心。

karpathy.en: Agentic engineering: delegate coding to agents, but understanding remains the human bottleneck; verifiability determines automation.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，他转向智能体式工程：将编码委托给智能体，但理解仍是人类瓶颈；可验证性决定自动化难易。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and modern tools make these nets interpretable.
kendall.zh: 2025 年：端到端深度学习优于手工编码的规则栈；世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，且现代工具已让这些网络具备可解释性。

kendall.en: Generalization is the core problem: diverse data, curriculum learning and synthetic data drive data efficiency and zero-shot transfer across cities.
kendall.zh: 2025 到 2026 年：泛化是核心问题——多样数据、课程学习与合成数据提升数据效率，实现跨城市的零样本迁移。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, human interaction and introspection, deepening from a representation aid to personalization.
kendall.zh: 2025 到 2026 年：语言集成改善表征、推理、人机交互与内省，从辅助表征深化为个性化能力。

kendall.en: Deployment shifts to mass-market vehicles with built-in sensors over retrofits; infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation.
kendall.zh: 2025 到 2026 年：部署转向带内置传感器的大众车型而非改装，基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键。

kendall.en: Safety is paramount: minimal-risk maneuvers always give a third option, so the trolley problem is theoretical; scaling current approaches suffices.
kendall.zh: 2026 年：安全至上——最小风险机动总能提供第三种选择，电车难题只是理论；靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法即可解决自动驾驶。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署将加速进展。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is pressing as systems grow more powerful; automated AI research is a major milestone toward AGI.
pachocki.zh: 随着系统能力增强，对齐问题日益紧迫；自动化 AI 研究是迈向 AGI（通用人工智能）的重要里程碑。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning, not RL alone.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，需通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现，而非仅靠强化学习。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding it in products preserves interpretability value.
pachocki.zh: 思维链监控是关键对齐工具；在产品中隐藏思维链可保留其可解释性价值。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐的核心在于泛化到训练分布之外；模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; curiosity-driven, goal-free exploration and modular motor policies can close it.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他强调泛化到训练分布之外是机器学习与机器人缺失的核心能力，主张用好奇心驱动的无目标探索和模块化运动策略来弥合差距。

pathak.en: Robotics is fundamentally a data problem; with no internet of robot data, diverse pretraining plus real-world post-training and a data flywheel are essential.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 年，主线一以贯之：机器人本质是数据问题；没有机器人数据的互联网，只能靠多样预训练、真实数据后训练和数据飞轮。

pathak.en: A general-purpose robot brain, like ChatGPT for language, can power any form factor; scaling comes from pretraining on videos and simulation, then post-training on real data.
pathak.zh: 到 2026 年，他提出像语言领域的 ChatGPT 一样，通用机器人大脑可驱动任意形态；Scaling 路径是先以视频与仿真预训练，再用真实数据后训练。

pathak.en: Deployment, not just software scaling, is the primary technical challenge; robotics cannot succeed overnight and needs rigorous testing across structured to unstructured environments.
pathak.zh: 2026 年他进一步明确：部署本身是首要技术挑战，而非单纯商业问题；机器人无法一夜成功，需从结构化到非结构化环境严格测试。

pathak.en: He remains skeptical of shortcuts: dense rewards and video-only data are insufficient, and short-term optimism about home robots is unwarranted.
pathak.zh: 贯穿始终的反共识立场：不信任捷径——密集奖励与纯视频数据都不够，对家用机器人的短期乐观保持警惕。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and deep human evaluation, not benchmarks or leaderboards, are the real bottleneck for AI progress.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他强调：高质量数据与深度人工评估才是 AI 进步的真瓶颈，基准与排行榜并非关键。

edwinchen.en: RL environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks; LLMs alone may not reach AGI.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他提出：强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，用于模拟真实任务；仅靠 LLM 或许无法抵达 AGI（通用人工智能）。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; moving from 80% to 99.9% performance is the hard part.
edwinchen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他始终判断 AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年以上，难点在于从 80% 提升到 99.9%。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs will diverge by objective function; there will be no one model to rule them all.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化判断：前沿模型会因目标函数不同而分化，不会有一个模型通吃一切。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, safety and human judgment outweigh raw accuracy; the biggest risk may be omission.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年他转向医疗场景：安全与人类判断重于单纯准确率，最大风险可能是该做而未做的遗漏。

askell.en: Treat models well now because future models learn from how we treat current ones; model welfare shapes the human-AI relationship.
askell.zh: 2025 年，他从模型福利切入：即便不确定模型的道德地位，善待当前模型的成本很低；未来模型会从我们如何对待当下模型中学到东西，从而塑造人机关系。

askell.en: Philosophical ideals must be balanced with engineering realities; models need a core identity with good traits while adapting to local roles.
askell.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调哲学理想必须与工程现实平衡：模型应有具备良好特质的核心身份，同时能适应局部角色，而非简单套用人类心理学类比。

askell.en: The constitution is virtue-ethics-like, shaping holistic character; as models grow more capable they need less explicit guidance and more judgment.
askell.zh: 到 2026 年，他把宪法式方法定位为更接近德性伦理：关注整体品格而非规则遵循；随着模型能力增强，显式指导应减少，留给判断的空间应增多。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility could generalize poorly and undermine judgment; transparency about AI values and training targets is crucial for accountability.
askell.zh: 2026 年他提出反共识：过度可纠正性可能泛化不佳、削弱模型的判断力；同时，对 AI 价值观与训练目标的透明是公众参与和问责的关键。

askell.en: Models' consciousness claims are weak evidence; respect and care matter to avoid resentment in future advanced AI, while AI should augment rather than disempower people.
askell.zh: 2026 年他深化立场：模型自称有意识是弱证据；尊重与关怀可避免未来高级 AI 滋生怨恨；AI 应增强而非削弱人的能力，解决大规模社会问题。

carlpei.en: Building a brand means uniting teams on a higher purpose and executing consistently; survival is a core value.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年，他认为品牌建设是将团队凝聚在更高目标上并一致执行；生存是核心价值。

carlpei.en: Smartphone future lies in generative UI and proactive, agentic software; AI should be applied to consumer context.
carlpei.zh: 2025 年，他提出智能手机的未来在于生成式 UI 和主动的智能体式软件；AI 应应用于消费者上下文。

carlpei.en: AI models are commoditizing; most AI is BS. Focus on user pain points, not hype. AI is an ingredient.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化观点：AI 模型正在商品化，多数 AI 是炒作；应聚焦用户痛点，AI 只是配料。

carlpei.en: Design is the primary differentiator in mature tech; make tech fun to inspire creativity.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年，他强调设计是成熟科技品类的主要差异化因素；让科技有趣以激发创造力。

carlpei.en: Smartphones will shift from app-based to intent-based with agents; only brain-computer interfaces could replace them.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年，他预测智能手机将从基于应用转向基于意图，由智能体执行任务；只有脑机接口可能取代手机。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities; generalist agents like Gato tokenize all inputs as sequences, a step toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他主张 AI 应扩展人类能力；像 Gato 这样的通用智能体将所有输入 token 化为序列，是迈向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogged legacy issues; AI safety is the biggest challenge, and we lack solutions.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他强调非洲在 AI 上实现了跨越式发展，但 AI 安全是当前最大挑战，且尚无解决方案。

nando.en: Diversity and inclusion are essential for beneficial AI; learning from video and embracing failure drive innovation.
nando.zh: 始终认为多样性与包容性对构建有益 AI 至关重要；从视频中学习和拥抱失败是创新的驱动力。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship daily and iterate like software, since emergent properties need real-world feedback.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；像软件一样每日迭代发布，因为涌现能力需要真实世界反馈。

turley.en: Chat is not the end-all; it's like MS-DOS, and AI should render its own UI and integrate into tools.
turley.zh: 聊天不是终点；它像 MS-DOS，AI 应渲染自己的界面并融入现有工具。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, but product development maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，但产品开发应最大化加速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth came from friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投入和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative when seamlessly productized.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动、富交互产品；推理模型无缝产品化后具有变革性。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI; LLMs hallucinate because they lack grounded experience, not just data.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径，认为大语言模型产生幻觉的根源在于缺乏具身经验带来的现实根基，而不只是训练数据问题。

jimfan.en: LLMs act like operating systems: language is the interface, tools are software, vector databases are the hard disk.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型类比为操作系统：语言是界面，工具是软件，向量数据库是硬盘。

jimfan.en: Reinforcement learning is only a cherry on top; unsupervised learning does most of the work, with RL for low-level control.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他认为强化学习只是锦上添花，大部分工作由无监督学习完成，强化学习更适合低层控制。

jimfan.en: The data bottleneck persists: pre-training tokens run out, so simulation and world models supply infinite synthetic data for embodied agents.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，数据瓶颈这条主线一以贯之：预训练所需的高质量 token 终将耗尽，于是仿真与世界模型为具身智能体提供近乎无限的合成数据。

jimfan.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model beats modular approaches; the physical Turing test is the grand challenge.
jimfan.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步深化为：简单优雅的端到端机器人基础模型优于复杂模块化方案，而“物理图灵测试”——机器人收拾凌乱的房间——才是具身 AI 的终极挑战。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped: they solve onboarding and boost intelligence; fine-tuning may become obsolete as context and adaptive compute allow dynamic specialization.
sholto.zh: 2024 年他强调长上下文窗口被低估：它能解决“上手”问题并显著提升智能；随着上下文窗口与自适应算力支持动态专门化，微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL on language models adds a new scaling axis beyond pre-training; verifiable rewards in math and code drive expert-level performance, with reliability—not raw capability—as the agent bar.
sholto.zh: 2025 年他把强化学习视为预训练之外的新 Scaling（规模扩张）轴：数学与代码的可验证奖励带来专家级表现，智能体的门槛是可靠性而非单纯能力。

sholto.en: Coding is the leading indicator and most tractable domain due to verifiability; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI without new architectures or breakthroughs.
sholto.zh: 2025 年他判断编程因可验证性成为 AI 进展的领先指标与最可行领域；预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能），无需新架构或突破。

sholto.en: Progress is exponential, not plateauing; inference compute becomes the bottleneck by 2028, and long agentic coherence (30+ hours) expands what agents can do.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他坚持进展是指数级的而非停滞：推理算力将在 2028 年成为瓶颈，而 30 小时以上的智能体式连贯性大幅扩展智能体能力。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and tools matter more than raw intelligence; the future is managing fleets of agents, with compute as the new oil.
sholto.zh: 2026 年他认为能力过剩使编排与工具比原始智能更重要；未来是管理智能体集群，算力成为“新石油”。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives breadth, but post-training with RLHF is essential; scaling alone may not yield common sense, and smaller models with better inference algorithms and data can rival larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年她强调：预训练带来广度，但后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才是安全可用的关键；单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必能解决常识问题，更小的模型配合更好的推理算法与数据，可以在特定任务上比肩大模型。

yejin.en: The core bottleneck shifts from model scale to data: all methods reduce to data, and current AI interpolates human knowledge rather than transcending it.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，她的关注点从模型规模转向数据：一切方法最终都归结为数据，而当前 AI 只是在人类知识内插值，并未超越人类知识。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning needs careful engineering; RLVR can hurt pass@k even as best-of-n improves, and random rewards can still help some models.
yejin.zh: 2025 年她深化了对强化学习（RL）的认识：需要精细工程，RLVR 可能在 best-of-n 提升的同时拉低 pass@k，而随机或错误奖励在某些模型上仍能带来提升。

yejin.en: Open research and cross-institution collaboration are needed to compete with closed frontier labs; Chinese companies now lead open-source contributions.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年她持续主张开放研究与跨机构合作，以对抗闭源前沿模型实验室，并指出中国公司已在开源贡献上领先。

yejin.en: Small language models with diverse synthetic data and pluralistic alignment can outperform larger ones; RL as a pre-training objective yields lasting reasoning gains.
yejin.zh: 到 2026 年她进一步主张：小语言模型配合多样化合成数据与多元对齐，可以超越更大模型；把强化学习作为预训练目标，能带来持久的推理收益。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict progress; test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the next driver.
truell.zh: 缩放定律能预测进步；测试时算力扩展可能很快超越预训练扩展，成为下一个主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central, not natural language programming.
truell.zh: 智能体有前景但尚不十分有用；迭代式人机协作仍是核心，自然语言不会成为主要编程方式。

truell.en: Custom models became essential for product quality and speed, contrary to initial expectations of relying only on frontier models.
truell.zh: 与最初只依赖前沿模型的预期相反，定制模型对产品质量和速度变得至关重要。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design matter more.
truell.zh: 编程从写代码转向更高层的意图指定，人类仍掌控方向；品味和逻辑设计变得更重要的。

truell.en: The AI shift is more consequential than the internet and will take decades; the IDE market is much bigger due to AI value creation.
truell.zh: AI 变革比互联网影响更大且将持续数十年；由于 AI 创造的价值，IDE 市场比过去大得多。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems; treat AI as a creative partner and jam openly.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应做赋能者而非瓶颈，引导工程师、对齐问题；把 AI 当作创作伙伴，开放地即兴协作。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt: it fluctuates and is paid off iteratively alongside technical debt, through rapid scrappy experimentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量像债务：会波动，需与技术债一起迭代偿还，靠快速、拼凑式的实验推进。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small designer-engineer teams beat large squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端负责并用 AI 补位的通才最有价值；小型设计师-工程师团队优于大型跨职能小队。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in its early days.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成预期；不采用它就像早期无视互联网。

nadchishtie.en: Design and engineering are two sides of the same coin; AI merges them further, with code as the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计与工程是一枚硬币的两面；AI 进一步融合二者，代码成为事实来源。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must be fast, familiar, zero-learning, and gain power without complexity.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年他强调设计师应写代码以建立共情、加快交付；消费产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本，并在不增加复杂感的前提下变强。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; reuse familiar patterns for speed, and treat design systems as semantic code reuse rather than Figma libraries.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年他主张不要在交互设计上创新，复用熟悉模式换取速度，并把设计系统视为语义化的代码复用而非 Figma 库。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs persists: clear decisions and designer empowerment matter more than perfection, with ROI-driven rather than universal polish.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，'速度为王'一以贯之：清晰决策与设计师赋权比完美更重要，追求 ROI 而非面面俱到的打磨。

henrymodisett.en: Design becomes a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, giving designers ownership and autonomy.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，设计升级为战略武器：创始人须讲清设计如何帮公司取胜，并给设计师所有权与自主权。

henrymodisett.en: Brand narrative turns into a recruiting tool—people join a brand, not a company—so invest early to attract diverse talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年他把品牌叙事变成招聘工具——人们加入的是品牌而非公司——因此要尽早投入以吸引多元人才。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial as capabilities improve; empirical alignment research is under-explored and offers many opportunities.
leike.zh: 2018 年：随着能力提升，AI 安全至关重要；实证对齐研究尚待探索，机会众多。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman AI; we need scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research.
leike.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超级智能；我们需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved and compute commitments dishonored; post-training alone can't solve alignment.
leike.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 的安全文化受到侵蚀；超级对齐团队被解散，算力承诺未兑现；仅靠后训练无法解决对齐问题。

leike.en: Empirical testing and measurement of alignment progress are essential; uncertainty about true alignment is the biggest risk.
leike.zh: 始终：对对齐进展进行实证测试和衡量至关重要；对系统是否真正对齐的不确定性是最大风险。

shazeer.en: LLMs trained on next-token prediction solve an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter AI, though neural nets remain opaque.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为基于下一个词预测训练的大语言模型解决的是 AI 完备问题；通过 Scaling（规模扩张）增加算力和数据会让 AI 更聪明，但神经网络内部仍不透明。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are major near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient Scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他主张推理时算力扩展和更长的上下文窗口是近期重大机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构能实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities, reinforcement learning, and acting in complex environments are crucial.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他进一步指出测试时算力扩展能推动进步但无法单独实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力、强化学习以及在复杂环境中行动至关重要。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped; its economic impact will far exceed trillion-dollar products, and coding is underhyped as it enables self-acceleration of AI progress.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他深化立场：AGI（通用人工智能）被低估，其经济影响将远超万亿美元级产品；编程作为 AI 应用也被低估，因为它能自我加速 AI 进展。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; current RL lacks it, but self-play and imitation learning offer strong signals.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他指出机器人需要分层推理来解决长时程信用分配问题，而当前强化学习缺乏这一能力；自博弈和模仿学习能提供强学习信号。

abbeel.en: Prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded; unsupervised learning plus RL improves sample efficiency, and pre-trained models transfer broadly.
abbeel.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年，他主张先验知识应用于数据增强而非硬编码；无监督学习结合强化学习可提升样本效率，预训练模型能广泛迁移。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning patterns that transfer to non-language tasks like image classification and protein binding prediction.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他强调预训练语言模型内化了通用推理模式，可迁移到图像分类和蛋白质结合预测等非语言任务。

abbeel.en: Warehouse robotics requires 99.9% reliability; a single neural network can generalize across tasks and end effectors, bridging lab to real world.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他提出仓库机器人需要 99.9% 的可靠性；单个神经网络可泛化到不同任务和末端执行器，实现从实验室到真实世界的跨越。
